text: Nag-abante na ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa round of 16 sang WTA Linz Open matapos ginlutos si Julia Grabher sang Austria, 6-4 6-3, sa imbukada nga hampang.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala advanced to the round of 16 of the WTA Linz Open after defeating Julia Grabher of Austria, 6-4 6-3, in the opening match.

text: Ini ang una nga tion nga nag-atubangay sanday Eala kag Grabher sa WTA Tour.
english: This is the first time Eala and Grabher have faced each other on the WTA Tour.

text: Nagapang-87 subong ang amo nga Austrian player sa WTA, samtang nagapang-46 naman sa ranking ang 20-anyos nga Pinay.
english: The Austrian is currently ranked 87th in the WTA, while the 20-year-old Filipina is ranked 46th.

text: Sunod nga atubangon ni Eala si 2017 French Open champion kag world no.
english: Eala will next face 2017 French Open champion and world no.

text: 23 Jelena Ostapenko sa masunod nga round.
english: 23 Jelena Ostapenko in the next round.

text: Samtang padayon ang hampang sang Pinay sa Austria, gin-anunsyo man nga nag-qualify siya sa main draw sang Stuttgart Open (Porsche Tennis Grand Prix) sa Germany sa masunod nga semana.
english: While the Filipina continues to play in Austria, it was also announced that she qualified for the main draw of the Stuttgart Open (Porsche Tennis Grand Prix) in Germany next week.

text: Siya ang magabulos sa Olympic champion nga si Qinwen Zheng sang China sa main draw matapos nga nag-withdraw ini sa kumpetisyon kasunod sang injury.
english: She will replace Olympic champion Qinwen Zheng of China in the main draw after she withdrew from the competition following an injury.

text: Kun yara na sa main draw, buot silingon, indi na maghampang si Eala sa qualifying matches kag magapreparar na lang sa pag-atubang sa field sa players kaangay kanday Mirra Andreeva, Jasmine Paolini, kag mangin ang defending champion nga si Ostapenko.#
english: If it is in the main draw, it means that Eala will not play in the qualifying matches and will only prepare to face the field against players like Mirra Andreeva, Jasmine Paolini, and even the defending champion Ostapenko.

text: Nagnubo ang purchasing power sang piso sa nagligad nga walo ka tuig bangud sa nagataas nga inflation, nga nagdangat sa pinakamadasig sini nga pagtaas sa sulod gid lamang sang 20 ka bulan sang Marso, suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).
english: The purchasing power of the peso has declined in the past eight years due to rising inflation, which reached its fastest increase in just 20 months in March, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA).

text: Suno kay National Statistician kag PSA Chief Claire Dennis Mapa, ang balor sang P1 sang 2018 ang katumbas na lamang sang 75 sentimo subong nga Marso 2026.
english: According to National Statistician and PSA Chief Claire Dennis Mapa, the value of P1 in 2018 is only equivalent to 75 cents as of March 2026.

text: Bangud sini, ang P1,000 nga balor sa nagligad nga walo ka tuig ang nagnubo sa P750.
english: As a result, the P1,000 value in the past eight years has dropped to P750.

text: Ang purchasing power sang piso ang gina-compute sa 1 divided by the consumer price index, multiplied by 100.
english: The purchasing power of the peso is computed as 1 divided by the consumer price index, multiplied by 100.

text: Ginalantaw nga ang madasig nga pagtaas sang inflation ang nagapanguna nga rason sang pagnubo sang balor sang piso, nga naglab-ot sa 4.1% sang bulan Marso 2026 bangud sa sunod-sunod nga mega pump price hikes dala man sang nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa Middle East.
english: The rapid rise in inflation is believed to be the main reason for the depreciation of the peso, which reached 4.1% in March 2026 due to a series of mega pump price hikes caused by the ongoing unrest in the Middle East.

text: Gin-athag sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) Iloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory sa Ungka, Jaro nga indi konektado kag wala nagaubra sa ila opisina ang subject sa ginkasa nga buy-bust operation sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4 sa San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) clarified that the subject of the buy-bust operation launched by the Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4 in San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City is not connected and does not work in their office.

text: Ang subject amo si alyas Lepay, 34 anyos, dala man sa nadakpan ang tiyo sini nga nabaklan man sang ilegal nga droga.
english: The subject was alias Lepay, 34 years old, who was also arrested with his uncle who was also bought illegal drugs.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jail Superintendent Denver Beltran, Jail Warden sang Iloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory, iya ginapahayag nga antes pa ini magpungko bilang bag-o nga Jail Warden sang Nobyembre 2025, may ara na nga daan sang Inmate Visitors Association (IVA), agud may mabilinan sang gamit sa gwa lang sang pasilidad bangud limitado lang ang madala nga gamit sang mga nagabisita sa mga Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jail Superintendent Denver Beltran, Jail Warden of the Iloilo City District Jail Male Dormitory, said that before he took office as the new Jail Warden in November 2025, there was already an Inmate Visitors Association (IVA), so that there would be enough equipment in the facility because the facilities were limited. visiting Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs).

text: Samtang, isa ka bulan antes ang buy-bust operation sang ICPS 4, nagpakig-angut na ini sa ila rason nga gin-usisa ini sang ila talatapan apang nagpanginwala si alyas Lepay nga ini ang nagapalusot sang ilegal nga droga.
english: Meanwhile, a month before the buy-bust operation of ICPS 4, he contacted them and their office investigated him but alias Lepay denied that he was smuggling illegal drugs.

text: kahapon nga adlaw, nakig-istorya na si Beltran sa Inmate Visitors Association (IVA ) nga kakason na ang gintukod nila nga “baggage area” sa gwa sang pasilidad kag mangita na lang sang bag-o nga espasyo para sa seguridad sang District Jail Male Dormitory.
english: yesterday, Beltran talked to the Inmate Visitors Association (IVA) to remove the baggage area outside the facility and find a new space for the security of the District Jail Male Dormitory.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang natungdan nga hugot ang ila security measures kun sa diin, antes makasulod sa visiting area ang mga bisita sang mga PDLs, ginapangitaan ini nila sang valid nga identification card, ginapapirma, ginapaidalom sa body search kag, kun makaisa, sa strip search—isa ka maid-id nga pag-usisa sa mga bisita sang PDLs lakip na ang ila dala kag may naka-roving nga personnel kag mga security camera.
english: He also assured that their security measures are strict where, before entering the visiting area, the visitors of the PDLs are asked for a valid identification card, signed, subjected to a body search and, sometimes, a strip search—a thorough search of the visitors of the PDLs including their security personnel. camera.

text: Magluwas sina, may ara man sang regular nga greyhound operation ang ila opisina sa bug-os nga pasilidad.
english: Besides that, their office also has a regular greyhound operation throughout the facility.

text: Maga-abot sa Pilipinas ang tatlo sa original members sang F4 nga sanday Jerry Yan, Vic Chou, kag Vanness Wu, kaupod ang front man sang Taiwanese band nga Mayday nga si Ashin.
english: Three of the original members of F4, Jerry Yan, Vic Chou, and Vanness Wu, will arrive in the Philippines, along with the front man of the Taiwanese band Mayday, Ashin.

text: Kabahin ang Manila sa libuton sang grupo para sa “F Forever” tour apang wala pa ginhatag ang eksakto nga petsa sang ila pagbisita sa pungsod.
english: Manila is part of the group's itinerary for the “F Forever” tour but the exact date of their visit to the country has not been given.

text: Umpisahan ang ila world tour sa Chongqing, China sa April 10-12, pagasundan sang Jakarta, Indonesia sa May 29 -30, kag may tour stops man sa Bangkok, Singapore kag Kuala Lumpur.
english: Their world tour will begin in Chongqing, China on April 10-12, followed by Jakarta, Indonesia on May 29-30, and will also have tour stops in Bangkok, Singapore and Kuala Lumpur.

text: Wala nalakip sa lineup si Ken Chu.
english: Ken Chu was not included in the lineup.

text: Antes pa man sini, nagkumpirma na ang singer-actor sang Disyembre nga indi siya mag-upod sa long-anticipated comeback bangud wala siya nalakip sa istoryahanay sa reunion concerts.
english: Earlier, the singer-actor confirmed in December that he would not participate in the long-anticipated comeback because he was not included in the conversation at the reunion concerts.

text: Gin-alegar sini anay nga wala nakahatag ang B’in Music sang contract ukon formal agreement.
english: He previously alleged that B’in Music failed to provide a contract or formal agreement.

text: Nakilala ang F4 kasunod sang hit 2001 drama nga “Meteor Garden” nga nangin cultural phenomenon sa Asia lakip na sa Pilipinas.
english: F4 became known after the hit 2001 drama “Meteor Garden” which became a cultural phenomenon in Asia including the Philippines.

text: Ini nga series ang nakabase sa Japanese manga nga “Boys Over Flowers” ni Yoko Kamio kun sa diin bida si Barbie Hsu ukon mas bantog nga si Shan Cai.
english: The series is based on the Japanese manga “Boys Over Flowers” ​​by Yoko Kamio starring Barbie Hsu or more famously Shan Cai.

text: Napatay si Barbie sang Pebrero 2025 bangud sang influenza-related pneumonia.
english: Barbie died in February 2025 due to influenza-related pneumonia.

text: Bilang isa naman ka music group, naka-release ang F4 sang albums lakip na ang “Meteor Rain” (2001), “Fantasy 4ever” (2002), kag “Waiting for You” (2007).
english: As a music group, F4 has released albums including “Meteor Rain” (2001), “Fantasy 4ever” (2002), and “Waiting for You” (2007).

text: Nag-updanay ang F4 members sa walo ka tuig, apang nagseparar sang banas sang 2009.
english: The F4 members were together for eight years, but parted ways in 2009.

text: Nahibaluan nga subong man nga adlaw ang una nga hearing sang impeachment complaint batok kay VP Duterte sa kamara.
english: The first hearing of the impeachment complaint against VP Duterte in the House of Representatives will be held today.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sa karun sang problema nga ginapangatubang ang pungsod, ilabi na ang problema sa gatong nga nagakadapat nga unahon sang mga opisyales sang gobyerno, ilabi na nga ang Pilipinas ang dependent sa importation sang amo nga produkto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco, he said that there are many problems facing the country, especially the problem of fuel that should be given priority by government officials, especially that the Philippines is dependent on the importation of such products.

text: Dugang pa ni Atty. Yusingco nga dapat anay pokusan ang legislation, pareho sang pag-amyenda sang oil deregulation law nga dako gid nga bulig sa isyu sang nagataas nga presyo sang langis sa subong nga tion.
english: He added that Atty. Yusingco said the focus should be on legislation, such as the amendment of the oil deregulation law which is a big help in the issue of rising oil prices at this time.

text: Paathag ni Yusingco nga ang nasambit nga mga isyu ang dako nga makaapekto sa kadam-an kag sa recovery sang pungsod sa kabilugan kag kinaganhlan gid hatagan sang maid-id nga pagtalakay kag solusyon.
english: Yusingco explained that these issues will greatly affect the public and the recovery of the country as a whole and need to be given a thorough discussion and solution.

text: Gin-ulan sang pagpanginbulahan ang Philippine National Women’s Football team matapos nag-qualify sa ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga tion nga makahampang sa FIFA Women’s World Cup.
english: The Philippine National Women's Football team was showered with congratulations after qualifying for the second consecutive time to play in the FIFA Women's World Cup.

text: Natabo ini matapos ginlutos sang Filipinas ang Uzbekistan, 2-0, sa eliminator round sa AFC Women’s Asian Cup sa Gold Coast Stadium sa Australia.
english: This happened after the Philippines defeated Uzbekistan, 2-0, in the eliminator round of the AFC Women's Asian Cup at the Gold Coast Stadium in Australia.

text: Naka-goal para sa Philippine team si Angie Beard sa ika-47 nga minuto, kag singko minutos ang nakaligad, ginsundan ini sang goal ni Jackie Sawicki.
english: Angie Beard scored for the Philippine team in the 47th minute, and five minutes later, it was followed by a goal from Jackie Sawicki.

text: Pareho nga si Jael-Marie Guy ang nag-assist agud nga maka-skor ang duha ka players sang Filipinas, kag siya man ang gindeklarar nga Player of the Match.
english: Both Jael-Marie Guy assisted to score the two Filipino players, and she was also declared Player of the Match.

text: Gindayaw ni Filipinas head coach Mark Torcaso si Guy sa pagpanikasog sini nga mapadaog ang team sa amo sini kadaku nga mga hampang.
english: Philippines head coach Mark Torcaso praised Guy for his efforts to win the team in such big games.

text: Ginpasalamatan man sini ang kada myembro sa ila kabakod apisar pila ka beses sila nga nalutos sa tournament lakip na ang 7-0 nga score sang ginpierde sila sang Japan.
english: He also thanked each member for their strength despite several defeats in the tournament including the 7-0 score when they were defeated by Japan.

text: “Even before the game, I told Jael this is your time to shine.
english: “Even before the game, I told Jael this is your time to shine.

text: And she put in two fantastic crosses that set us up in the second half.
english: And she put in two fantastic crosses that set us up in the second half.

text: There was nothing I said apart from keep doing what we’re doing, hoping the young players do something special,” suno kay Torcaso sa post-match press conference.
english: There was nothing I said apart from keep doing what we’re doing, hoping the young players do something special,” Torcaso said in the post-match press conference.

text: “To have one of our future stars, I think a star on the world stage, play so well in a big game like this and help us qualify for the World Cup is a testament to her and her family.
english: “To have one of our future stars, I think a star on the world stage, play so well in a big game like this and help us qualify for the World Cup is a testament to her and her family.

text: Jael is just one of the number of players coming through our program to be successful for the national team for many, many years,” dugang sini.
english: Jael is just one of the number of players coming through our program to be successful for the national team for many, many years,” it added.

text: Para naman kay Guy, ang ila pagbalik sa World Cup amo ang bunga sang teamwork kag kapisan sang kada isa samtang yara sa pitch.
english: For Guy, their return to the World Cup is the result of teamwork and effort from each other while on the pitch.

text: “As someone who is younger on the team, this is something I’ve dreamed about since I was little.
english: “As someone who is younger on the team, this is something I’ve dreamed about since I was little.

text: Going to the World Cup is something that seems unreachable until it happens.
english: Going to the World Cup is something that seems unreachable until it happens.

text: I just feel very excited and grateful,” ginpakigbahin sini sa interview.
english: I just feel very excited and grateful,” she shared in the interview.

text: “None of this wouldn’t have been possible if we didn’t work together and be confident in each other.
english: “None of this would’ve been possible if we didn’t work together and be confident in each other.

text: I’m just super grateful and super happy and super excited to go to Brazil next summer,” dugang ni Guy.
english: I’m just super grateful and super happy and super excited to go to Brazil next summer,” Guy added.

text: Sang 2023 ang debut sang Filipinas sa FIFA Women’s World Cup.
english: In 2023 the Philippines will debut in the FIFA Women’s World Cup.

text: Magluwas sa ila, naka-qualify man para sa World Cup sa Brazil sa 2027 ang Australia, Japan, China, South Korea, kag ang North Korea.
english: In addition to them, Australia, Japan, China, South Korea, and North Korea have also qualified for the World Cup in Brazil in 2027.

text: Magaabot na sa masunod nga semana ang una nga batch sang masobra isa ka milyon nga bariles sang krudo nga ginbakal sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas.
english: The first batch of more than one million barrels of crude oil purchased by the Philippine government will arrive next week.

text: Katumbas ini sang 165.67 million litro nga suplay.
english: This is equivalent to 165.67 million liters of supply.

text: Suno kay Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, gin-order sang Department of Energy (DOE) ang amo nga langis kag makadugang ini sa suplay sang pungsod sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw.
english: According to Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, the Department of Energy (DOE) ordered the oil and it will increase the country's supply within five days.

text: Pahayag sini, kabahin ini sang target sang gobyerno nga makabakal sang tubtub 2-million barrels sang diesel.
english: He said this is part of the government's target to purchase up to 2-million barrels of diesel.

text: “[T]he oil diplomacy ably conducted by energy officials led by Secretary Sharon Garin has resulted in the firm order of 1.04 million barrels of diesel, with the first batch arriving this week,” pahayag sang opisyal.
english: “[T]he oil diplomacy ably conducted by energy officials led by Secretary Sharon Garin has resulted in the firm order of 1.04 million barrels of diesel, with the first batch arriving this week,” the official said.

text: May yara sang gin-invest nga ginabanta P20 billion sa idalom sang Emergency Energy Security Program sang DOE para sa sini nga procurement.
english: An estimated P20 billion has been invested under the DOE's Emergency Energy Security Program for this procurement.

text: Gin-finalize ang kasugtanan sa suppliers paagi sa Philippine National Oil Company Exploration Corp..
english: The agreement with the suppliers was finalized through the Philippine National Oil Company Exploration Corp..

text: nga ginapanag-iyahan man sang gobyerno.
english: which is also owned by the government.

text: Wala ginkumpirma sang gobyerno kun sanday sin-o ang kuhaan sini sang suplay, apang una ginpahayag nga gina-explore sini ang posible nga makahatag indi lamang sa Southeast Asia kundi mangin sa Japan, Canada, kag United States.
english: The government did not confirm who it would source supplies from, but initially said it was exploring possible suppliers not only in Southeast Asia but also in Japan, Canada, and the United States.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, may nag-abot nga masobra 700,000 barrels sang krudo halin sa Russia nga gin-import man sang Pilipinas.
english: Last week, more than 700,000 barrels of crude oil arrived from Russia that the Philippines also imported.

text: Ang consignee amo ang Petron Corp nga amo ang naga-operate sang isahanon nga oil refinery sang Pilipinas sa Limay, Bataan.
english: The consignee is Petron Corp which operates the Philippines' only oil refinery in Limay, Bataan.

text: Patay ang duha ka mga lalaki matapos gintiro sang security guard nga ila gin-bully sa Cebu City.
english: Two men were shot dead by a security guard they bullied in Cebu City.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, pila ka beses na nga gina-bully sang mga biktima ang suspek.
english: According to the investigation, the victims had been bullying the suspect several times.

text: Pahayag sang, madugay na ini nga nagaugtom kag nagapugong apang sang amo nga tion, nagdulom na ang iya panulukan kag nahimo ang krimen.
english: He said he had been hungry and restrained for a long time but by that time, his eyesight had become dark and he committed the crime.

text: Samtang, ginpanginwala naman sang asawa sang isa sa mga biktima nga gina-bully sang iya bana ang gwardiya.
english: Meanwhile, the wife of one of the victims denied that her husband was bullying the guard.

text: Sa subong, preso na ang suspekkag mangatubang sang nagakaigo nga kaso.
english: The suspect is currently in custody and will face appropriate charges.

text: Ginpatawag sang House Justice Panel si Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla agud magtestigo sa nagapadayon nga hearing sang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The House Justice Panel summoned Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla to testify in the ongoing hearing of the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa ginpagwa nga subpoena, ginmanduan si Remulla nga magtambong sa hearing sa Abril 14, alas-10 sang aga, sa House of Representatives sa Quezon City.
english: In the subpoena, Remulla was ordered to attend a hearing on April 14, 10 am, at the House of Representatives in Quezon City.

text: Ginmanduan man ini nga dal-on ang mga Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) ni Duterte halin sang 2007 tubtob 2013, 2016 tubtob 2022, kag 2022 tubtob 2025.
english: It was also ordered to bring Duterte’s Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) from 2007 to 2013, 2016 to 2022, and 2022 to 2025.

text: Suno sa komite, ginapangayo ang mga dokumento agud nga mabusisi ang gin-deklarar nga manggad sang Bise Presidente halin sang iya pagsugod sa serbisyo tubtob subong.
english: According to the committee, the documents are being sought in order to verify the declared wealth of the Vice President since he took office until now.

text: Ginpahanugutan man si Remulla nga mag-dala sang abogado.
english: Remulla was also allowed to bring an attorney.

text: Sa matandaan, kabahin ini sang pagtalakay sa duha ka pending nga impeachment complaint batok kay Duterte, nga nagaangot sa mga alegasyon sang sala nga paggamit sang confidential funds.
english: It can be recalled that this is part of the discussion of two pending impeachment complaints against Duterte, which are related to allegations of misuse of confidential funds.

text: Liwat nga ginkilala bilang ‘Best City Police Office’ ang Iloilo City Police Office sa PNP DAY 2026 nga ginhiwat sa PNP Multi-Purpose Center sa Camp Crame, Quezon City.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office was once again recognized as the 'Best City Police Office' at the PNP DAY 2026 held at the PNP Multi-Purpose Center in Camp Crame, Quezon City.

text: Ini ang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga nakuha sang ICPO ang nasambit nga award.
english: This is the second consecutive year that the ICPO has won the award.

text: Personal ini nga ginbaton ni ICPO OIC Colonel Wilbert Parilla.
english: He was personally received by ICPO OIC Colonel Wilbert Parilla.

text: Sa mensahe ni PCol Parilla, iya ginapalab-ot ang pagpasalamat kay former ICPO Director PCol Legada, sa tanan nga ICPO personnel, sa supporta nga ginhatag sang Iloilo City Government, kag sa koordinasyon man sang mga Ilonggo.
english: In his message, PCol Parilla expressed his gratitude to former ICPO Director PCol Legada, to all ICPO personnel, for the support given by the Iloilo City Government, and for the coordination of the Ilonggos.

text: Ini nga kadalag-an indi lang para sa ICPO kundi pati man sa bug-os nga syudad sang Iloilo.
english: This victory is not only for the ICPO but also for the entire city of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PMAJ.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PMAJ.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, Spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ila gid nga ginakalipay ang nabatun nga award.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, Spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Station, said they are very happy to receive the award.

text: Suno man sa iya, ang mga sunod-sunod nga nabatun nila nga mga kadalag-an amo ang isa ka challenge para sa mga katapo sang kapulisan kag inspirasyon agud nga mas mangin maayo pagid ang ila nga performace.
english: He said the successive victories they have received are a challenge for the police officers and inspiration to improve their performance.

text: Ginahandaan sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang posible nga pagdeklara sang state of calamity bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong sa pungsod.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government is preparing for the possible declaration of a state of calamity due to the continuous rise in fuel prices in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., iya ginpahayag nga gin-convene na ang Provincial Community Defense Cluster agud preparahan ang posible nga deklarasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said the Provincial Community Defense Cluster has been convened to prepare for a possible declaration.

text: Suno sa gobernador, kinahanglan anay sang nagakaigo nga datos halin sa mga kabanwahanan antes patigayunon ang nasambit nga plano kag ginahulat man nila nga may duha ka banwa nga magdeklara sang state of calamity bilang basehan.
english: The governor said they need proper data from the municipalities before implementing the plan and they are also waiting for two municipalities to declare a state of calamity as a basis.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa subong, may yara na sang duha ka kabanwahanan nga nagdeklara kag amo ini ang banwa sang Ajuy kag New Lucena, Iloilo.
english: It is known that so far, there are two towns that have declared and these are the towns of Ajuy and New Lucena, Iloilo.

text: Dugang pa ni Defensor nga kinahanglan nga tun-an ini kaupod ang mga department heads agud lantawon ang mga praktikal nga pamaagi base sa available nga resources sang probinsya.
english: Defensor added that this needs to be studied with the department heads to look at practical ways based on the available resources of the province.

text: Nahibaluan nga may ara sang P82 milyon nga quick response fund ang probinsya nga mahimo gamiton para sa emergency measures kun matigayon ang deklarasyon.
english: The province has a P82 million quick response fund that can be used for emergency measures if the declaration is obtained.

text: Ginpa-anggid sa sikat nga fictional character subong online nga si “Linda Walker” si Miss universe 2020 Rabiya Mateo matapos nagpanguna sa National Medical Admission Test (NMAT).
english: Miss universe 2020 Rabiya Mateo has been compared to the popular fictional character online “Linda Walker” after she topped the National Medical Admission Test (NMAT).

text: Ini matapos makakuha sang 741 nga puntos sa beauty queen, nga nagbutang sa iya sa Top 1 sa mga examinees sa Pilipinas.
english: This is after scoring 741 points in the beauty queen, which put her in the Top 1 among the examinees in the Philippines.

text: Nalapawan naman sini ang score sang fictional character nga si Linda Walker sa drama nga “The Heiress Who Won with Brains” nga nakakuha naman sang 719 points sa NMAT.
english: She surpassed the score of fictional character Linda Walker in the drama “The Heiress Who Won with Brains” who scored 719 points in the NMAT.

text: Si Rabiya ang produkto sang Iloilo Doctors’ College kag nag-graduate bilang cum laude sa kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Physical Therapy.
english: Rabiya is a product of Iloilo Doctors’ College and graduated cum laude with a Bachelor of Science in Physical Therapy.

text: Ginpakigahin man sini sang nagligad nga mga binulan nga gusto sini magbalik sa medical school kag isa sa mga tikang sini amo ang pagkuha sang NMAT.
english: He also shared in recent months that he wants to go back to medical school and one of his steps is to take the NMAT.

text: Sa madumduman nga ginpasapubliko ni Rabiya nga nagasuprer ini sang depresyon kag anxiety.
english: Rabiya revealed that she suffers from depression and anxiety.

text: Suno pa sa Ilongga beauty queen nga gusto sini gamiton ang iya kalam kag ihibalo para makabulig sa iban.
english: The Ilongga beauty queen said she wants to use her knowledge and skills to help others.

english: Major Jerome Jacuba, who was blinded after being hit by a bomb while serving in Maguindanao in 2016, has been promoted to the position of “Major” by the Philippine Army.

text: Sa video‑statement nga ginpagua sang Presidente, iya ginpahayag nga indi makatarungan nga basta lang mapahamtang sa Complete Disability Discharge (CDD) ang mga suldado nga nasamaran tungod sang ila trabaho.Ginmando niya ang suspensyon sang discharge ni Jacuba kag ang paghatag sang bag-o nga trabaho (adaptive duties) nga husto sa iya 15 ka tuig nga serbisyo.

text: Subong man, lubos nga ginbaton ni Major Jerome Jacuba ang pasidungog kag suporta sang gobyerno,kag nagapasalamat sa oportunidad nga makapadayon sa iya serbisyo sa pungsod apisar pa sang naagum sini nga disabilidad sa pagpakigbato para sa pungsod.

english: The 70-year-old American Pope himself carried the large cross through all 14 stations in the procession that marks the 14 last events of Jesus' life — from his execution to his burial.

text: Si Pope Leo XIV ang ikaduha nga Santo Papa sa maragtas sang Simbahan nga nagdala sang Krus sa bilog nga Via Crucis.

english: Department of Transportation (DOTr) Acting Secretary Giovanni Lopez will talk to Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Secretary Rex Gatchalian to provide assistance to bus conductors as they are not included in the government's fuel subsidy.

english: DOTr Secretary Giovanni Lopez said he will approach them through the DSWD's Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) program.

english: DSWD Secretary Rex Gatchalian assured that their agency is open to assist those who will be referred to them.

text: Dugang pa ni Gatchalian nga kun ma-endorso na kag mapamatud-an, gilayun nga makabatun sang bulig ang mga benepisyaryo.
english: Gatchalian added that once endorsed and verified, the beneficiaries will receive the assistance immediately.

text: Sa baylo nga mga dumuluong kag mga tumuluo ang magapuno sa Jerusalem subong nga Semana Santa, nangibabaw ang kahadlok kag kahangawa sang kadam-an bangud sang nagapadayon nga giyera sa Middle East.
english: Instead of foreigners and believers filling Jerusalem this Easter, fear and anxiety prevailed because of the ongoing war in the Middle East.

text: Sirado ang kadam-an sa mga simbahan, holy sites, kag mangin ang mga balaligyaan bangud wala sang mga turista nga nagaabot.
english: Most churches, holy sites, and even shops are closed because no tourists are coming.

text: Hugot man ang ginpatuman nga security restrictions.
english: Security restrictions were also strictly enforced.

text: Sa kinaandan, sang nagligad nga mga tinuig, linibo nga mga Katoliko ang nagapili sang Jerusalem nga ila kadtuan para sa pilgrimage, Stations of the Cross, kag para magbisita sa Church of the Holy Sepulchre.
english: Typically, in recent years, thousands of Catholics have chosen Jerusalem as their destination for pilgrimage, Stations of the Cross, and to visit the Church of the Holy Sepulchre.

text: Ginadugukan man anay ang Via Dolorosa ukon ang makitid nga alagyan nga ginapatihan gin-agyan ni Hesus antes ini ginpatay kag ginlansang sa Krus.
english: The Via Dolorosa or the narrow path that Jesus is believed to have walked before he was killed and crucified was also visited.

text:
DAYON ANG MGA AKTIBIDAD SA HOLY SEPULCHRE

Sa press release sang Vatican, ginpagwa ang joint statement sang Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem kag Custody of the Holy Land.
english:
THEN THE ACTIVITIES AT THE HOLY SEPULCHRE

In a press release, the Vatican issued a joint statement of the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem and the Custody of the Holy Land.

text: Diri ginkumpirma nga ang tanan nga aktibidad kaangot sa Semana Santa kag Easter sa Church of the Holy Sepulchre ang na-address na kag na-resolba nga may koordinasyon sa mga awtoridad.
english: It was confirmed that all activities related to Holy Week and Easter at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre have been addressed and resolved in coordination with the authorities.

text: “In agreement with the Israeli Police, access for representatives of the Churches has been secured in order to conduct the liturgies and ceremonies and to preserve the ancient Easter traditions at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre,” kabahin sang statement.
english: “In agreement with the Israeli Police, access for representatives of the Churches has been secured in order to conduct the liturgies and ceremonies and to preserve the ancient Easter traditions at the Church of the Holy Sepulchre,” the statement read.

text: Matandaan nga sang Domingo de Ramos, ginbalabagan sang Israeli Police ang Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem nga si Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa kag Fr Francesco Ielpo, Custos of the Holy Land, samtang yara sa gwa sang simbahan antes maghiwat sang misa sa pagmarka sang pagsugod sang Semana Santa.
english: It can be recalled that on Palm Sunday, Israeli Police blocked the Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem, Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa and Fr Francesco Ielpo, Custos of the Holy Land, while they were outside the church before holding a mass to mark the beginning of Holy Week.

text: Nagpahayag ang opisina ni Cardinal Pizzaballa nga ini ang una nga tion sa madamo nga mga siglo nga wala ginpasulod ang Latin Patriarch sa holy site sa mismo Palm Sunday.
english: Cardinal Pizzaballa's office said it was the first time in centuries that the Latin Patriarch was not allowed to enter the holy site on Palm Sunday.

text:
MAHIMO MA-STREAM ANG MGA AKTIBIDAD

Sa joint statement, ginpahayag man nga bangud sang nagapadayon nga gyera sa Middle East, madamo gihapon sang pagpanghugot sa public gatherings.
english:
ACTIVITIES CAN BE STREAMED

The joint statement also said that due to the ongoing war in the Middle East, there are still many restrictions on public gatherings.

text: Bangud sini, naghatag ang Simbahan sang live streaming sang liturgies and prayers para nga makaupod gihapon ang mga tumuluo sa Holy Land kag sa kalibutan nga espiritwal nga mga hilikuton.#
english: Because of this, the Church provided live streaming of liturgies and prayers so that the faithful can still be with the Holy Land and the world's spiritual activities.

text: Nagdeklarar ang International Criminal Court (ICC) Pre-Trial Chamber 1 nga fit si former President Rodrigo Duterte nga magpadayon para sa pre-trial proceedings sa gina-atubang sini nga kaso nga crimes against humanity.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) Pre-Trial Chamber 1 has declared former President Rodrigo Duterte fit to proceed for pre-trial proceedings in the crimes against humanity case he is facing.

text: Sa ginpaguwa nga 25 ka pahina nga desisyon, ginbasura sang ICC ang request sang kampo ni Duterte para sa indefinite adjournment sang kaso.
english: In a 25-page decision, the ICC rejected the Duterte camp's request for an indefinite adjournment of the case.

text: Gin-schedule man sang chamber ang pag-umpisa sang confirmation of charges hearing sa Pebrero 23, 2026.
english: The chamber also scheduled the start of the confirmation of charges hearing on February 23, 2026.

text: Matandaan nga may panel sang medical experts nga nag-check sa ikaayong lawas sang anay presidente matapos nga gin-alegar sang kampo sini nga malipaton na si Duterte kag indi na makadumdom sang mga hitabo, mga petsa, kag mangin sa iya pamilya.
english: It can be recalled that a panel of medical experts checked the health of the former president after his camp alleged that Duterte is forgetful and cannot remember events, dates, and even his family.

text: Una naman nga ginbasura sang korte ang ila request para sa interim release.
english: The court earlier rejected their request for interim release.

text: Marso 11, 2025 sang gindakop si Duterte kag gindala sa The Hague, Netherlands bangud sa kaso nga nag-ugat sa kontrobersyal sini nga drug war.
english: On March 11, 2025, Duterte was arrested and brought to The Hague, Netherlands on charges stemming from his controversial drug war.

text: SANG SINI LANG, ang DILG nag-isyu sang Memorandum Circular No.
english: RECENTLY, the DILG issued Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2026-006 agud istriktuhon ang pagpatuman sang Anti-Epal Policy.
english: 2026-006 to strictly enforce the Anti-Epal Policy.

text: Ginmando dayon gani sini ang pagpangkakas na sang mga ngalan, larawan (images) kag kanawong (likeness) sang mga public officials halin sa tanan nga “govt-funded projects, programs, activities kag properties”.
english: He immediately ordered the removal of the names, images and likeness of public officials from all “govt-funded projects, programs, activities and properties”.

text: Lakip diri ang logo, initial, color motif, slogan ukon bisan ano nga identifying symbol ang makita sa mga signages, markers, tarpaulin, kag ang kahawig nga mga materyales nga nagapakilala sang kaangtanan sang public official, labi na gid sang mga pulitiko, sa mga ini nga nagastuhan ukon ginagastuhan sang public funds.
english: This includes logos, initials, color motifs, slogans or any identifying symbol appearing on signage, markers, tarpaulins, and similar materials that identify the relationship of public officials, especially politicians, to those who spend or are spent by public funds.

text: Gin-stress pa ni DILG Sec.
english: DILG Sec.

text: Jonvic Remulla nga ang mga ini indi dapat gamiton para sa personal promotion, tungod ginapondohan ini sang buhis sang taxpayers, sa kabug-usan, kag dapat ang kredito dira makadto sa mga pumuluyo kag indi para sa political promotion sang pulitiko.
english: Jonvic Remulla said these should not be used for personal promotion, because they are funded by taxpayers, in general, and the credit should go to the people and not for political promotion of politicians.

text: Ginalikawan man sini ang paggamit pa sining mga epal materials sa pag-claim sang personal credit nga nagapapati sa mga pumuluyo nga natigayon ining mga kaayuhan paagi sa ila ikasarang, gali kay wala gid sila kalabot-labot dira.
english: It also avoids the use of these epal materials to claim personal credit that makes the people believe that these benefits were achieved through their ability, when they have nothing to do with it.

text:
***

Of course, sugot kita sa sining DILG Anti-Epal Policy, bangod sa malain mismo nga experyensya sang mga pumuluyo parti sa sining mga epal nga ini.
english:
***

Of course, we agree with this DILG Anti-Epal Policy, because of the bad experience of the people regarding these apples.

text: Pagpatalang (deception) lang ang kalabanan sini.
english: Most of it is just deception.

text: Ginapapati lang sini ang mga pumuluyo nga ang pulitiko ang nagduso kag nagpatigayon sining mga govt-funded projects, programs, activities kag properties paagi sa ila pagpaningasug kag ikasarang, gali kay wala sila kalabot-labot dira.
english: It only makes the people believe that the politicians proposed and implemented these govt-funded projects, programs, activities and properties through their efforts and abilities, when they had nothing to do with it.

text: Labi na gid ang mga proyekto nga napondohan na sa National Budget (GAA) kag ang pagpatuman sini obligasyon na sang DPWH kag iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno nga indi na kinahanglan entrahan pa sang mga pulitiko.
english: Especially the projects that have already been funded in the National Budget (GAA) and their implementation is the obligation of the DPWH and other government agencies that do not need to be interfered by politicians.

text:
***

May daku ugaling nga problema sa pagpatuman sining Anti-Epal Policy, kay sa pagkadula sang ining mga epal materials, ginadula ta man ang kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo sa paghibalo sa mga kaayuhan nga nahimo man sang mga public official sunu sa ila gid pagpaningasug kag ikasarang nga dapat man kilalahon sang mga pumuluyo kag pasalamatan.
english:
***

However, there is a big problem in the implementation of this Anti-Epal Policy, because with the loss of these epal materials, we also lose the right of the people to know the good things that public officials have done according to their efforts and abilities that should also be recognized and thanked by the people.

text: In fact, “unfair” man sa public official nga itago sa mga pumuluyo ang kaayuhan nga ila gid nahimo sing bunayag (honest), kapin pa kon ang kredito makadto pa sa indi deserved.
english: In fact, it is “unfair” for a public official to hide from the people the good they have done honestly, especially if the credit goes to the undeserving.

text: Tungod sini, bagay lang nga hibaluon kag athagon gid sa ining Anti-Epal Policy kon ano gid ang mga “specific exceptions” nga posible mahimo nila nga indi maka-violate sining epal policy.
english: Therefore, it is appropriate to know and clarify in this Anti-Epal Policy what are the specific exceptions that they may make without violating this Epal Policy.

text:
***

Tungod man kay indi ma-specify sing maathag ang buot silingon sang Constitution, pati na ang mga enabling laws and regulations, naniguro ang pila ka LGU agud magpasar gid sang ila mga enabling nga mga ordinansa angot sa sining Anti-Epal Policy.
english:
***

Also, because the Constitution does not clearly specify the meaning of the enabling laws and regulations, some LGUs have tried to pass their enabling ordinances regarding this Anti-Epal Policy.

text: Katulad sang Ordinance No.
english: As per Ordinance No.

text: 2025-006 sang Naga City sa Bicol nga nagapatuman sang PhP5,000-fine kag/ukon 30 tubtub 180 ka adlaw nga pagka-bilanggo, luas ang pagsabat sang mga kagastuhanan sa pagkakas sining mga materyales.
english: 2025-006 of Naga City in Bicol which imposes a PhP5,000-fine and/or 30 to 180 days imprisonment, except to cover the costs of removing these materials.

text: Yara man ang Anti-Epal Ordinance of 2022 sang Pasig City, nga nagasukot man sang PhP5,000 nga fine nga may upod nga pagkabilanggo sa indi magkubos sa anom (6) ka bulan.
english: There is also the Anti-Epal Ordinance of 2022 of Pasig City, which also imposes a PhP5,000 fine accompanied by imprisonment for at least six (6) months.

text: Wala man ugaling ginapahayag sa ining mga ordinansa ang specific gid nga exceptions, kag kon ano ang paghangop sang mga ini nga posible maka-exempt sa penalidad kon himuon ini sang public official.
english: However, these ordinances do not specify the specific exceptions, and how they understand that it is possible to exempt from penalty if done by a public official.

text:
Katulad abe sang panindugan ni Iloilo City Liga president Irene Ong, samtang wala pa sing naaprubahan nga Anti-Epal Odinance ang siyudad, nga “Indi sakop sang Anti-Epal Policy ang mga posters nga may itsura sang alkalde nga ginapatapik sa sulod sang barangay hall.”

Ginaupdan naton ining panindugan ni Kap Ong nga mapasugtan ang pagpaskil sang larawan ni Mayor Raisa sa barangay hall bilang pagpakita sang respeto sa kay meyor sa iya pagpamuno sa siyudad.
english:
Similar to the position of Iloilo City Liga president Irene Ong, while the city has not yet approved an Anti-Epal Ordinance, that “The Anti-Epal Policy does not cover posters with the mayor's image posted inside the barangay hall.”

We support Kap Ong's stand to allow the posting of Mayor Raisa's picture in the barangay hall as a sign of respect for the mayor in his leadership of the city.

text: Ang pagsulundan sa katilingban indi lang ginagamhan sang Constitution kag sang mga enabling laws kag regulasyon, kundi lakip man dira sng well-entrenched nga mga tradisyon nga gina-respeto naton bilang kabahin na sang aton kultura.
english: Social order is not only governed by the Constitution and enabling laws and regulations, but also by well-entrenched traditions that we respect as part of our culture.

text: Katulad sang paghatag sang respeto sa aton katigulangan kag mga pamunuan sa ila poder sa pamilya kag sang aton katilingban.
english: Like giving respect to our ancestors and leaders in their power in the family and our society.

text: Tungod sini, segurado naton nga may madumduman pa gid nga mga exception ang iban sa aton sa idalom sining Anti-Epal Policy.
english: Because of this, we are sure that some of us will remember exceptions under this Anti-Epal Policy.

text: In fact, kay ang isyu batok sa pamulitika, pwede gani mangin exception dira ang mga pahibalo nga gasugid lang sang matuod sang naamot nga pagpanikasug sang mga public official.
english: In fact, since the issue is against politics, announcements that tell the truth about the efforts of public officials can be an exception.

text: Katulad sang higayon nga maka-coordinate ang LGU, nga ginpasugtan ni PBBM sa pag-ayu ni Mayor Raisa, sa DPWH agud ma-amendar kag mapatigayon ang mas mabungahon nga pagpatukod sang proyekto.
english: Like the opportunity for the LGU, which was allowed by PBBM at the request of Mayor Raisa, to coordinate with the DPWH to amend and facilitate the more productive construction of the project.

text: Sa balita nga nabaton naton, may hingyo si Mayor Raisa sa DPWH nga pasangkaron pa ang alagyan sang tubig baha sa idalom sang bikelane road.
english: According to the news we received, Mayor Raisa has requested the DPWH to widen the flood water channel under the bikelane road.

text: Nga kon pasugtan, matudlo ini nga significante nga amot ni meyor para sa kaayuhan sang mga pumuluyo nga indi masiling nga pamulitika.
english: That if allowed, it will be pointed out as a significant contribution of the mayor for the welfare of the people that cannot be said to be politics.

text: Kag ayhan matugtan ang signboard nga nagasiling: “Salamat sa DPWH sa pagpasangkad sang alagyan sang tubig baha sa bikelane road.
english: And maybe the signboard that says: “Thank you DPWH for widening the floodway on bikelane road.
