text: Ginbasura sang Iran ang ginaduso nga ceasefire sa tunga nila sang Israel kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Iran has rejected the proposed ceasefire between Israel and the United States of America.

text: Gin-report ini sang state media apisar nga nagahingapos na ang latid nga ginhatag ni US President Donald Trump.
english: This was reported by state media despite the fact that the deadline given by US President Donald Trump is coming to an end.

text: Pahayag sang state media, napalab-ot na nila ang ila sabat sa key mediator nga Pakistan.
english: According to state media, they have already conveyed their response to key mediator Pakistan.

text: “Iran has conveyed to Pakistan its response to the American proposal to end the war,” suno sa news agency nga IRNA.
english: “Iran has conveyed to Pakistan its response to the American proposal to end the war,” according to the IRNA news agency.

text:
“In this response -– set out in ten points –- Iran… has rejected a ceasefire and insists on the need for a definitive end to the conflict.”

Sa separado nga pahayag ni Mojtaba Ferdousi Pour, head sang Iranian diplomatic mission sa Cairo, ginsiling sini nga indi lang basta-basta nga ceasefire ang ila luyag.
english:
“In this response -– set out in ten points –- Iran… has rejected a ceasefire and insists on the need for a definitive end to the conflict.”

In a separate statement, Mojtaba Ferdousi Pour, head of the Iranian diplomatic mission in Cairo, said they wanted more than just a ceasefire.

text: Ang gusto siguraduhon sang Tehran suno sa iya amo ang pagtakop sang gyera nga may garantiya nga indi na sila pag-atakehon liwat.
english: What Tehran wants to ensure, he said, is an end to the war with a guarantee that they will not be attacked again.

text: “We won’t merely accept a ceasefire,” pahayag sang amo nga opisyal sa The Associated Press.
english: “We won’t merely accept a ceasefire,” the official told The Associated Press.

text:
“We only accept an end of the war with guarantees that we won’t be attacked again.”

Matandaan nga nagpaandam si Trump nga itapok sini ang Iran sa impyerno pananglitan indi magsugot sa negosasyon.
english:
“We only accept an end of the war with guarantees that we won’t be attacked again.”

Trump warned that he would throw Iran into hell if it did not agree to negotiations.

text: Gusto ni Trump nga buksan ang Strait of Hormuz; kun indi, suno sa iya, maga-atake ang US sa mga power plant kag sa mga taytay sang Tehran.
english: Trump wants to open the Strait of Hormuz; otherwise, he said, the US will attack Tehran’s power plants and bridges.

text: Samtang nga padayon ini nga bayluhanay sang paandam, nag-atake naman ang Israel sa daku nga petrochemical plant sa South Pars natural gas field kun sa diin napatay ang duha ka paramilitary Revolutionary Guard commanders.
english: While this exchange of warnings continues, Israel attacked a large petrochemical plant in the South Pars natural gas field where two paramilitary Revolutionary Guard commanders were killed.

text: Nagpadayaw ang Israel nga ang ila ginhimo nga atake ang mahimo makadula sang major source sang revenue para sa Iran, bangud ang amo nga gas field ang kritikal para sa electricity production.
english: Israel boasted that its attack could eliminate a major source of revenue for Iran, as that gas field is critical for electricity production.

text: Gintawag man ni Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz ang amo nga planta bilang largest petrochemical facility sang Iran.#
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz also called the plant Iran's largest petrochemical facility.

text: Ginkondenar sang legal counsel ni Anne Curtis ang mga ginbuy-an nga mga pahayag ni Congressman Bong Suntay nahanungod sa aktres kadungan sang ila committee hearing sa Kamara.
english: Anne Curtis' legal counsel condemned Congressman Bong Suntay's released statements about the actress during their committee hearing in the House of Representatives.

text: Ginlaragway sang abogado nga ”inappropriate ukon unacceptable” ang pahayag ni Suntay kaangot sa iya desire kag imagination sang nakita sini si Anne.
english: The lawyer described Suntay's statement regarding his desire and imagination when he saw Anne as "inappropriate or unacceptable".

text: Suno sa sulat nga ginpadala sang legal counsel ni Anne, ang pagdalahig sa pangalan sang aktres nagapakita lamang sang isa ka indi manami kag wala nagakaangay nga topiko sa hearing sang Kongreso.
english: According to the letter sent by Anne’s legal counsel, the involvement of the actress’s name only reflects an unpleasant and inappropriate topic in the Congressional hearing.

text: Gindugang pa sang kampo sang aktres nga ang amo sini nga mga pahayag nagapakanubo sang dignidad sang kababa-inhan kag wala ini lugar sa bisan ano nga forum, ilabi na sa Kongreso kun sa diin ginapaabot ang mga opisyal magpakita sang respeto.
english: The actress' camp added that such statements degrade the dignity of women and have no place in any forum, especially in Congress where officials are expected to show respect.

text: Ginpahanumdom man sang legal counsel ni Anne ang importansya sang pag-promote sang pagrespeto kag dignidad sang kababa-inhan, nga ginakilala nga layi sang Pilipinas kaangay sang Safe Spaces Act kag Magna Carta of Women.
english: Anne's legal counsel also reminded the importance of promoting the respect and dignity of women, which is recognized as Philippine law such as the Safe Spaces Act and Magna Carta of Women.

text: Samtang, nagreact man ang manghod ni Anne nga si Jasmine Curtis-Smith kag ang ila iloy batok sa ginbuy-an nga komento, samtang madamo man nga celebrities ang nagpahayag sang ila pagkadismaya sa social media.
english: Meanwhile, Anne's younger sister Jasmine Curtis-Smith and their mother also reacted against the released comment, while many celebrities also expressed their disappointment on social media.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpangayo man sang pasaylo ang asawa sang mamalidha nga si Sheila Guevara Suntay kay Anne kag sa iya pamilya, kag nagpahayag nga wala sang babayi nga dapat hambalan sang kaangay nga mga tinaga.
english: Meanwhile, the wife of the lawmaker, Sheila Guevara Suntay, also apologized to Anne and her family, and said that no woman should be told such words.

text: Nagpangabay man ini sa publiko nga indi pagdalahigon ang iya mga kabatan bangud wala ang mga ini sang ihibalo sa nabuhat nga sala sang ila amay.
english: He also appealed to the public not to involve his children because they have no knowledge of their father's crime.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla nga ila na ginahandaan ang pagpasaka sang kaso nga plunder batok kanday former House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag former Senate President Chiz Escudero.
english: Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla confirmed that they are preparing to file plunder cases against former House Speaker Martin Romualdez and former Senate President Chiz Escudero.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa ginaalegar nga kaangtanan sang mga ini sa maanomalya nga flood control projects sang gobyerno.
english: This is in connection with their alleged links to the anomalous flood control projects of the government.

text: Ginalauman nga ini posible ipasaka sang Ombudsman sa masunod nga bulan sang Mayo matapos nga na-finalize ang kaso batok sa nasambit nga mga personalidad.
english: It is expected that the Ombudsman will likely file the case next May after the case against the said personalities is finalized.

text: Dugang pa sang Ombudsman nga madamo pa sang opisyal ang ila pagapasakaan sang kaso dala na diri ang pila ka mga executive officials.
english: The Ombudsman added that they will prosecute more officials including some executive officials.

text: Ginpahayag sang Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) nga indi matuod ang mga balita nga ubos na ang ila pondo kag sila ginakabig nga bankrupt.
english: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) has denied reports that it has run out of funds and is considered bankrupt.

text: Suno kay PhilHealth President kag Chief Executive Officer Edwin Mercado, sang siya nagtambong sa pagpamati sang House Committee on Health, padayon pa nga mabakod ang pondo sang ahensiya bangud sang mga ipon halin pa sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to PhilHealth President and Chief Executive Officer Edwin Mercado, when he attended the hearing of the House Committee on Health, the agency's funds remain strong due to savings from last year.

text: Ginpabutyag man niya nga may mga tikang na sila nga ginahimo agud mapataas pa ang koleksyon sang ahensiya.
english: He also said that they are already taking steps to increase the agency's collection.

text: Apang ginpangayo man sang PhilHealth ang dugang nga subsidy halin sa mga mamalidha bangud sang paglapad sang coverage sang mga benepisyo.
english: However, PhilHealth also requested additional subsidies from lawmakers due to the expansion of coverage of benefits.

text: Lakip sa ginadugangan nga serbisyo amo ang pagbulong sang cardiovascular diseases, dialysis, kidney operations kag iban pa nga mga critical nga bulong.
english: Among the increased services are the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, dialysis, kidney operations and other critical medicines.

text: Ginpahayag man sang ahensiya nga nagapangayo pa sila sang P21 bilyon nga pondo halin sa Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) kag Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) agud masiguro ang padayon nga serbisyo sa publiko.
english: The agency also said it is seeking P21 billion in funds from the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) and the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) to ensure continued service to the public.

text: Arestado ang 35-anyos nga gas station supervisor matapos ginpahayag nga gintaban sini ang P57 milyon nga balor sang kita sang gasolinahan sa Taft Avenue, Manila.
english: A 35-year-old gas station supervisor was arrested after he allegedly embezzled P57 million worth of revenue from a gas station in Taft Avenue, Manila.

text: Nadakpan ang babaye nga suspek sa isa ka manhunt operation sa Paranaque City.
english: The female suspect was arrested in a manhunt operation in Paranaque City.

text: Naaresto ini paagi sa gahom sang warrant of arrest sa 60 counts sang qualified theft.
english: He was arrested by virtue of a warrant of arrest on 60 counts of qualified theft.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginapeke sang suspek ang mga deposit slip sang bangko agud pagwaon nga nadeposito niya ang kita sang gasolinahan.
english: The suspect allegedly forged bank deposit slips to make it look like he had deposited the gas station's income.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad kaangot sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Ginaistoryahan sa Thai social media ang 24-anyos nga si Nong Fah matapos nag-ako ini nga gindungan niya nobyohon ang kapid nga mag-utod nga sanday Sing kag Suea.
english: 24-year-old Nong Fah is being discussed on Thai social media after she admitted that she was dating twin sisters Sing and Suea.

text: Nakilala niya ang kapid sa restaurant nga iya ginaubrahan bilang waitress.
english: She met the twins at the restaurant where she worked as a waitress.

text: Isa ka adlaw, nagkaon ang kapid sa restaurant kag ginsunlog ini nga ihatag ang iya phone number sa mag-utod.
english: One day, the twin was eating at a restaurant and was asked to give his phone number to the brothers.

text: Bangud ginhatag niya ini, nagpadala man sang mensahe ang duha ka kapid.
english: Because he gave it, the two twins also sent a message.

text: Didto na nahulog ang buot niya sa mag-utod kag amo man ang nabatyagan sang duha ka kapid sa iya.
english: That's when he fell in love with the brothers and the twins felt the same way about him.

text: Suno kay Fah, wala man sang nagakatabo nga pagpangimon sa tunga sang mag-utod kag nabaton man nila ang sitwasyon bangud pareho nila nga palangga ang dalaga.
english: According to Fah, there is no jealousy between the brothers and they accepted the situation because they both love the girl.

text: Sa subong, kapin anom ka bulan na sila nga nagaupdanay sa balay nga ginatiniran ni Fah.
english: As of now, they have been living together in the house where Fah lives for more than six months.

text: Sa pihak sang mga kritisismo halin sa netizens, wala na lang ginasapak ini sang tatlo.
english: Despite the criticism from netizens, the three ignored it.

text: Ginpasangkad pa sang Department of Health ang monitoring sa tunga sang pagtaas sang kaso sang hand, foot and mouth disease sa pungsod.
english: The Department of Health has expanded monitoring amid the increase in cases of hand, foot and mouth disease in the country.

text: Base sa datos sang ahensya sang Agosto 16, naglab-ut na sa 39,893 ang total nga kaso, nga may dugang nga sobra 2,000 sulod lang sang isa ka semana halin sang Agosto 9.
english: Based on the agency's data as of August 16, the total number of cases has reached 39,893, with an increase of more than 2,000 in just one week since August 9.

text: Ginpahayag sang Department of Health nga ang tunga sang mga apektado amo ang mga kabataan nga naga-edad isa tubtob tatlo ka tuig.
english: The Department of Health said half of those affected were children between the ages of one and three.

text: Ginkumpirmar man nga nagapakig-angot na ang ahensya sa mga lokal nga panguluhan agud mapabakod ang pagbantay sa mga rehiyon.
english: It was also confirmed that the agency is already working with local government units to strengthen surveillance in the regions.

text: Ginpahanumdom sang ahensya nga ang hand, foot and mouth disease isa ka makalalaton nga balatian nga nagalapta paagi sa laway halin sa pag-ubo, pagpangatsi, ukon pag-istorya.
english: The agency reminded that hand, foot and mouth disease is an infectious disease spread through saliva from coughing, sneezing, or talking.

text: Ginpahanumdom man nga kun may sintomas pareho sang hilanat, singaw sa baba, sakit sa tutunlan kag mga arikis sa kamot kag tiil, kinahanglan dayon magpakonsulta sa health center.
english: He also reminded that if there are symptoms such as fever, runny nose, sore throat and tingling in the hands and feet, it is necessary to consult the health center immediately.

text: Kag kun mild lang, ginarekomendar ang isolation sa sulod sang pito tubtob napulo ka adlaw kag ang regular nga paglimpyo sang mga gamit kag paghugas sang kamot sulod sang 20 ka segundo.
english: And if it's mild, isolation is recommended for seven to ten days and regular cleaning of utensils and hand washing for 20 seconds.

text: Nagsarurot pa ang balor sang Philippine peso sa panibag-o nga all-time low sa pagtakop sang trading subong nga hapon, Marso 27.
english: The Philippine peso fell to a new all-time low at the close of trading this afternoon, March 27.

text: Naglab-ot na sa P60.55 ang baylo sang isa ka US Dollar.
english: The exchange rate of one US dollar has reached P60.55.

text: Ini na ang pang-anum nga tion subong nga bulan nga nakadangat sa record low ang local currency.
english: This is the sixth time this month that the local currency has hit a record low.

text: Ginalantaw nga mas mabudlayan ang Pilipinas bangud kun magluya ang peso, mas magamahal ang pagbakal sang langis bangud dolyar ang ginagamit sa purchase.
english: The Philippines is expected to suffer more because if the peso weakens, it will be more expensive to buy oil because dollars are used for purchase.

text: Gina-import sang Pilipinas ang masobra 90% sang langis.
english: The Philippines imports more than 90% of its oil.

text: Kun magtaas ini, ginalantaw man nga magadasig pa ang inflation, gani nga nabutang man sa mabudlay nga sitwasyon ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas kaangot sa interest rate hikes.
english: If it rises, inflation is expected to accelerate, putting the Central Bank of the Philippines in a difficult situation regarding interest rate hikes.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam ang head sang International Energy Agency nga ang krisis nga nag-umpisa sa gyera sang US, Israel, kag Iran ang maghimo maglapaw pa sa combined shock sang 1970s oil crises kag disruption dala sang 2022 invasion sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: Earlier, the head of the International Energy Agency warned that the crisis that began with the war between the US, Israel, and Iran could go beyond the combined shock of the 1970s oil crises and disruption caused by Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

text:
‘DOUBLE WHAMMY’

Gintawag sang economic think tank nga IBON Foundation nga double whammy ukon duha ka dungan nga negatibo nga event ang pagsarurot sang balor sang Philippine peso kag ang pag-surge sang global oil prices.
english:
‘DOUBLE WHAMMY’

The economic think tank IBON Foundation called the depreciation of the Philippine peso and the surge in global oil prices a double whammy.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay IBON Foundation Executive Director Sonny Africa, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga duha ka bagay ang ginalantaw nga magapa-doble sang inflation sa masunod nga binulan nga maga-igu gid sa pigado nga mga pumuluyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, IBON Foundation Executive Director Sonny Africa said these two factors are expected to double inflation next month which will hit the poor.

text: Ginapahayag nga may maka-benepisyo sang pagluya sang peso kaangay sang mga pamilya sang overseas Filipino workers nga sa inisyal nga pagtulok amo ang makakuha sang dugang nga pesos sa kada dollar nga ginapadala sang ila pamilya abroad.
english: It is said that there are those who will benefit from the weakening of the peso such as the families of overseas Filipino workers who at first glance will get more pesos for every dollar sent by their families abroad.

text: Apang suno sa research group, bisan magsaka ang remittances sa peso terms, ma-offset gihapon ini sang mataas man nga domestic prices.
english: However, according to the research group, even if remittances rise in peso terms, it will still be offset by high domestic prices.

text: Diri na kag ginaduso sang grupo nga dapat nga may insigida nga tikang sang gobyerno, magpatunga na agud nga maproteksyunan ang purchasing power, suportahan ang palangabuhian, hagan-haganon ang inflationary pressures, kag indi dapat magpakuno-kuno nga normal lang ang tanan subong.#
english: The group is proposing that the government should take immediate action, intervene to protect purchasing power, support livelihoods, ease inflationary pressures, and not pretend that everything is normal now.

text: Wala nagpauli nga wala sang dala nga kadalag-an ang Gilas Pilipinas Women sa FIBA Women’s World Cup 2026 Qualifiers matapos malab-ot sang mga ini ang makasaysayan nga pagkadaog batok sa Colombia sa score nga 74-59, sa Astroballe sa France.
english: Gilas Pilipinas Women did not go home without a victory in the FIBA ​​Women's World Cup 2026 Qualifiers after they achieved a historic victory against Colombia with a score of 74-59, in Astroballe in France.

text: Ini ang una nga kadalag-an sang Pilipinas batok sa non-Asian team sa kasaysayan sang women’s program.
english: This is the first win for the Philippines against a non-Asian team in the history of the women’s program.

text: Nag-panguna sa makasaysayan nga pagkadaog si Kacey Dela Rosa nga nakakuha sang 25 points kag 19 rebounds.
english: Kacey Dela Rosa led the way in the historic win with 25 points and 19 rebounds.

text: Naghatag man sang dako nga suporta si Sugapong nga may 21 points, 3 assists, 2 rebounds, kag 2 steals samtang nagtapos ang Pilipinas sa ila campaign nga may record nga 1-4.
english: Sugapong also provided a big support with 21 points, 3 assists, 2 rebounds, and 2 steals as the Philippines finished their campaign with a record of 1-4.

text: Antes matabo ang pagkadaog sang Gilas, ginpierde anay sang mga ini ang South Korea sa score nga 105-74, agud tapuson ang ila qualifying run.
english: Before the Gilas' victory, they defeated South Korea 105-74 to end their qualifying run.

text: Ginpanginwala sang kampo sang South Korean singer, actress, kag television presenter nga si Sandara Park ang alegasyon nga nagagamit ini sang iligal nga droga.
english: The camp of South Korean singer, actress, and television presenter Sandara Park has denied allegations that she uses illegal drugs.

text: Kasunod ini sang akusasyon nga halin mismo sa 2NE1 bandmate sini nga si Park Bom.
english: This follows an accusation from his 2NE1 bandmate Park Bom.

text: Suno sa team ni Dara, “groundless” ang alegasyon, apang nagakahangawa man ini sa ikaayong-lawas sang iya nga bandmate.
english: According to Dara's team, the allegation is “groundless”, but he is also concerned about the health of his bandmate.

text: Matandaan nga gin-claim ni Park Bom nga gingamit lang siya nga cover-up agud nga indi masapubliko ang ginaalegar drug abuse ni Dara.
english: Park Bom claimed that he was used as a cover-up to keep Dara's alleged drug abuse from becoming public.

text: Sang 2010, gin-akusaran si Bom nga nag-import sang 82 pills sang Adderall.
english: In 2010, Bom was accused of importing 82 pills of Adderall.

text: Gina-regulate sa South Korea ang amo nga drugs bangud sa amphetamine content.
english: The drugs are regulated in South Korea because of their amphetamine content.

text: Gin-dismiss ang kaso bangud gin-clarify sang singer nga gingamit niya ang bulong agud nga ma-treat ang iya nga Attention Deficit Disorder.
english: The case was dismissed because the singer clarified that he used the drug to treat his Attention Deficit Disorder.

text: Sa iya naman alegasyon subong, ginpahayag ni Park Bom nga gingamit lang siya bilang scapegoat bangud si Dara ang matuod nga nagagamit sang drugs.
english: In his allegation, Park Bom said he was used as a scapegoat because Dara was the real drug user.

text: Matandaan nga natabo ang debut nanday Bom kag Dara bilang myembro sang K-pop girl group nga 2NE1 kaupod kanday CL kag Minzy.
english: Bom and Dara made their debut as members of the K-pop girl group 2NE1 alongside CL and Minzy.

text: Antes sa South Korea, nakilala anay si Dara sa Pilipinas paagi sa reality talent competition nga “Star Circle Quest” sang 2004 kun sa diin ginsuguran sini ang iya nga acting kag singing career.
english: Before South Korea, Dara was first known in the Philippines through the reality talent competition “Star Circle Quest” in 2004 where she started her acting and singing career.

text: Apisar sang global fame, nagabalik-balik ini sa Philippine television kag nakapungko man bilang judge sa 2016 talent competition nga “Pinoy Boyband Superstar,” kag gina-akomodar man sini ang guest appearances sa nagkalain-lain nga variety kag talk shows.#
english: Despite his global fame, he returns to Philippine television and also sat as a judge in the 2016 talent competition “Pinoy Boyband Superstar,” and he also accommodates guest appearances in various variety and talk shows.

text: Nagpanguna si Pope Leo XIV sa liturhiya sang Passion and Death of Our Lord Jesus Christ sa St.
english: Pope Leo XIV presided over the liturgy of the Passion and Death of Our Lord Jesus Christ at St.

text: Peter’s Basilica sa hapon sang Byernes Santo — ang isahanon nga adlaw sa tuig nga wala sang Holy Mass nga ginaselebrar.
english: Peter’s Basilica on the afternoon of Good Friday — the only day of the year when no Holy Mass is celebrated.

text: Sa pagsugod ang liturhiya nga nagakomemorar sang pag-antos sang Ginuo, naghapa ang Santo Papa sa atubang sang altar.
english: At the beginning of the liturgy commemorating the Lord's suffering, the Pope knelt before the altar.

text: Nagluhod naman ang iban nga mga pari kag ang mga tumuluo.
english: The other priests and the believers knelt down.

text: Sunod nga nagpangamuyo ang Santo Papa: “Remember your mercies, O Lord, and with your eternal protection sanctify your servants, for whom Christ, your Son, by the shedding of his Blood, established the Paschal Mystery, Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.
english: Sunod nga nagpangamuyo ang Santo Papa: “Remember your mercies, O Lord, and with your eternal protection sanctify your servants, for whom Christ, your Son, by the shedding of his Blood, established the Paschal Mystery, Who lives and reigns for ever and ever.

text:
Amen.”

Sa pagselebrar sang Simbahan sang Solemn Liturgy of the Passion of the Lord, ginpahat-pahat ini sa tatlo ka bahin: ang Liturgy of the Word, ang Adoration of the Cross; kag ang reception of Holy Communion.
english:
Amen.”

In the Church's celebration of the Solemn Liturgy of the Passion of the Lord, it is divided into three parts: the Liturgy of the Word, the Adoration of the Cross; and the reception of Holy Communion.

text: Matapos ang proklamasyon sang Passion, gin-deliver sang Preacher sang Pontifical Household nga si Fr.
english: After the proclamation of the Passion, the Preacher of the Pontifical Household, Fr.

text: Roberto Pasolini, OFM Cap, ang homily.
english: Roberto Pasolini, OFM Cap, the homily.

text: Ginpahanumdom ni Fr.
english: He reminded Fr.

text: Pasolini sa mga tumuluo nga sa balaan nga adlaw sang liturhiya, gina-imbitar ang tanan nga magpamalandong sa nangin pag-antos kag kasakit sang Ginuo.
english: Remind the faithful that on the holy day of the liturgy, all are invited to reflect on the suffering and pain of the Lord.

text: Ang Byernes Santo amo ang ikaduha sa apat ka Catholic holidays padulong sa Easter Sunday.
english: Good Friday is the second of four Catholic holidays leading up to Easter Sunday.

text: Sa amo nga adlaw, maga-deliver si Pope Leo sang special blessing kag mensahe halin sa balkonahe sang St.
english: On that day, Pope Leo will deliver a special blessing and message from the balcony of St.

text: Peter’s Basilica.#
english: Peter’s Basilica.#

text: Ginsita ni Senator Loren Legarda ang indi pagtambong ni Department of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin kag ginpahayag nga wala ini sa ila nga senate hearing bangud masako ini sa “pagpamolitika”.
english: Senator Loren Legarda cited the absence of Department of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin and said she was not present at their senate hearing because she was busy “politicizing”.

text: Nagtuad naman si Legarda nga kun kinahanglan nga mag-obra ang mga ini bisan holy week, himuon nila agud lamang mahatagan sang solusyon ang problema sang publiko sa gatong.
english: Legarda admitted that if they have to work even on holy week, they will do it just to provide a solution to the public's fuel problem.

text: Matapos ginpangita sa hearing, nag-abot man si Garin.
english: After being sought at the hearing, Garin also arrived.

text: Sa pagpadayon sang hearing, ginplastar ni Garin nga kampante siya nga may kuhaan ang gobyerno sang suplay sang langis agud mapabaskog ang reserba sang pungsod.Suno sa iya, kuhaon ang suplay halin sa iban nga pungsod kaangay sang South Korea, China, kag Japan.
english: In the continuation of the hearing, Garin said he is confident that the government will have a source of oil supply to strengthen the country's reserves. He said the supply will be sourced from other countries such as South Korea, China, and Japan.

text: Una na niya ginpahayag nga may 1 million barrels sang diesel nga ginatrabaho kag gina-order ang gobyerno nga balor P10 billion.
english: He earlier said the government has 1 million barrels of diesel being worked on and ordered worth P10 billion.

text: KILALA ang nagtaliwan nga OPM Icon nga si Ka Freddie (Ferdinand “Freddie” Pascual Aguilar) sa iya kabalaka sa nagakatabo nga social injustice sa sosyedad sa iya mga kanta.
english: THE late OPM Icon Ka Freddie (Ferdinand “Freddie” Pascual Aguilar) is known for his concern over social injustice in society in his songs.

text: Bisan pa nga nagapabilin ang iya pagpalangga sa aton pungsod nga iya ginapabatyag sa iya kanta nga “Bayan Ko” (2009), kag kabalaka gihapon sa ulibaron nga mga kabataan, nga ang isa sa ila anak niya mismo, sa iya internationally acclaimed nga kanta nga “Anak” (1983).
english: Although he remains his love for our country that he feels in his song “Bayan Ko” (2009), and still concern for orphaned children, one of whom is his own son, in his internationally acclaimed song “Anak” (1983).

text: Ginapautwas niya diri ang masubo nga nadangtan sang madamo niya nga mga kasimanwa sa pagpamigos sang mga poderoso sa sosyedad.
english: He expresses here the sad experience of many of his fellow citizens in the oppression of the powerful in society.

text: Subong man ang pagpabaya sang gobyerno sa kaayuhan sang mga kubos, bisan pa nga ginapaseguro ini sang aton 1987 Constitution sa idalom sang “common good” nga probisyon sini.
english: Also the government’s neglect of the welfare of the underprivileged, even though our 1987 Constitution ensures it under its “common good” provision.

text: Sa panahon sang Martial Law ni anay Presidente Marcos  Sr., gin-ban gani ang pila niya ka ambahanon.
english: During the Martial Law of former President Marcos Sr., some of his songs were even banned.

text: Ang “Katarungan” nga nagapakamalaut sa “unjustly accused”.
english: The “Justice” that condemns the “unjustly accused”.

text: Ang “Pangako” angot sa wala matuman nga pangako sa mga “abandoned people”.
english: The “Promise” is about the unfulfilled promise to the “abandoned people”.

text: Kag ang “Luzviminda” nga nagapanawagan sa mga pumuluyo nga magbangon batok sa nagakatabo nga pagpamigos sang mga poderoso sa tion nga ato sang “strongman  rule” sa idalom sang Martial Law.
english: And the “Luzviminda” which calls on the people to rise up against the oppression of the powerful during the time of “strongman rule” under Martial Law.

text:
***

Ang indi man malipatan nga kanta nga gapabatyag sang kabalaka ni Ka Freddie ang angot sa indi maayo nga nadangtan sang pila ka kababaehan naton.
english:
***

The unforgettable song that expresses Ka Freddie's concern is about the bad things that happened to some of our women.

text: Ini ang kanta nga “Magdalena”, nga galarawan sang isa ka babaye nga manubo sang lupad.
english: This is the song “Magdalena”, which depicts a woman with a low bird.

text: Nga ginahalintulad niya sa mga lin-ay sang kagab-ihon nga nahibal-an niya sa Mabini Street sa distrito sang Iloilo City Proper.
english: Which he compares to the nightlife he knew on Mabini Street in the Iloilo City Proper district.

text: Gin-mensyonar gani niya diri kon ano nga sahi sang lugar ang Mabini Street: “Kaya ika’y namasukan, doon sa Mabini napadpad; Mula noon, binansagang kalapating mababa ang lipad.”Subong, wala na ina nga imahen sang Mabini Street.
english: He even mentioned here what kind of place Mabini Street is: “So you’re in, there in Mabini napadpad; From then on, called kalapating low fly.” Today, that image of Mabini Street is gone.

text: Nagatindog na diri ang mga commercial buildings kag wala na ining mga “whore cottages” dira.
english: Commercial buildings are already standing here and these “whore cottages” are no longer there.

text:
***

May sabat dira ang mga gaulikid sa ikaayuhan moral kag pangabuhi sining mga lin-ay sang kagab-ihon, sa lugar nga itum-ok pa gid sila sa kasal-anan kag walay paglaum sa pangabuhi.
english:
***

There is an answer for those who care about the moral and social welfare of these night owls, instead of sinking them further into sin and hopelessness.

text: Ang kasubong nga pag-ulikid sa luyag magbag-o nga mga lin-ay sang kagab-ihon (prostitutes) ginahimo sang Mary Queen of Heaven Missionaries (MOHM) nga may mga Rescue Homes sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Similar care for prostitutes is provided by the Mary Queen of Heaven Missionaries (MOHM) with Rescue Homes across the country.

text: Diri sa Western Visayas may mga Rescue Homes ini sila sa Iloilo, Antique, Aklan kag Guimaras.
english: Here in Western Visayas, they have Rescue Homes in Iloilo, Antique, Aklan and Guimaras.

text: Ang misyon sang MOHM amo ang masunod: (1) Ang luwason ang mga kababaehan kag kabataan nga biktima sang prostitusyon; (2) Matagaan sila sang pasilungan (shelter) kag mabuligan sila sa pagpanibag-o sa isa ka Home of Love; kag (3) Matagaan sila sang oportunidad nga makapangabuhi sing disente nga ang aton Ginoong  Jesukristo ang sentro sang ila kabuhi.
english: The mission of the MOHM is as follows: (1) To rescue women and children who are victims of prostitution; (2) They will be given shelter and helped to rehabilitate in a Home of Love; and (3) They will be given the opportunity to live a decent life with our Lord Jesus Christ at the center of their lives.

text:
Ang mga program kag serbisyo sang MOHM galakip sang:

* Residential Care, kon diin ma-facilidad ang ila transition period paagi sa paghatag sang palibut (environment) nga makabulig patigayon sang bagay nga pagbag-o.

* Counseling kag Psychological therapy

* Livelihood and Skills Training

* Educational Assistance

* Reintegration Phase, nga isa ka monitoring kag support system nga may close consultation sa mga professional kag sang mga biktima mismo sang prostitusyon sa tunga nila, kag kon ano pa nga mahatag nga bulig sa ila.
english:
MOHM programs and services include:

* Residential Care, where their transition period can be facilitated by providing an environment that can help facilitate appropriate change.

* Counseling and Psychological therapy

* Livelihood and Skills Training

* Educational Assistance

* Reintegration Phase, which is a monitoring and support system with close consultation with professionals and the victims of prostitution themselves among them, and what other assistance can be given to them.

text: Nagabulig man ang Bahandian Repository sang Central Philippines University sa pag-monitor sang ila kahimtangan, ang mahibal-an gid kon ano ang mga rason sang ila paglab-ot sa ila sitwasyon, kag kon ano man ang mabulig sang mga ahensya sang gobyerno kag private sector groups sa ila.
english: The Bahandian Repository of the Central Philippines University also helps to monitor their situation, to know exactly what the reasons are for their situation, and what government agencies and private sector groups can do to help them.

text: Samtang, sa Siyudad sang Iloilo, si Nestor Canong nga hepe sang Task Force on Morals and Values Formation gasiling nga tungod illegal ang prostitusyon ginapangdakop gid ini sila, pati ang ila kaugyon nga mga bugaw (panderer).
english: Meanwhile, in Iloilo City, Nestor Canong, chief of the Task Force on Morals and Values ​​Formation, said that because prostitution is illegal, they are being arrested, including their panderers.

text: “Sa aton diri, sort of daw gina-intindi ta na lang (ugaling sila),” siling Canong tungod sa luyag man nila tani magbag-o ugaling kay wala sila makita nga matarong nga trabaho.
english: “For us here, we sort of understand (but they),” Canong said because they wanted to change but they didn't see the right job.

text: Gaayo gani sila, sunu kay Canong: “Tagae bala kami sang disente nga trabaho para may mapakaon kami sa amon kabataan.
english: They are even better, according to Canong: “Give us decent jobs so that we can feed our children.

text:
Bayaan namon ang amo ‘ni nga obra.”

Ano abe sa imo Mr. Canong, subong man sa City PESO, pwede naton bala matagaan trabaho ining mga lin-ay sang kagab-ihon sang ubra agud makapangabuhi sing disente kag mapalayo sila sa ila mahigko nga trabaho?
english:
We will leave this job.”

What about you Mr. Canong, as well as City PESO, can we give these lin-ay night jobs so that they can live a decent life and get them away from their dirty jobs?

text: May mabulig man bala ang TESDA?
english: Can TESDA help?

text: In fact, ang pagbulig sa may luyag magpanibag-o sang kabuhi obligasyon man naton ini, pati sang gobyerno, sa aton Ginoong Jesukristo sa Iya ejemplo sang paghatag sing kahigayunan sa pagpanibag-o sa kay Magdalena sa Bibliya./PN
english: In fact, helping those who want to change their lives is our obligation, as well as that of the government, to our Lord Jesus Christ in His example of giving the opportunity to change to Magdalene in the Bible./PN

text: Nagakahangawa sa karun ang Archdiocese of Jaro bangud sa naganubo nga numero sang mga kaparian sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro is now concerned about the declining number of priests in Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rev.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rev.

text: Fr.
english: Fr.

text: Angelo Colada, Director sang Social Communication sang Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpakigahain nga madamo sa karun sang mga parochial church sa probinsya sang Iloilo ang nagaproblema sa kakulangan sang pari.
english: Angelo Colada, Director of Social Communication of the Archdiocese of Jaro, said that many parochial churches in Iloilo province are currently facing a shortage of priests.

text: Dugang pa ni Fr.
english: Fr. added.

text: Colada nga masami nagaka-delay ang mga misa sa iban nga simbahan bangud wala sang mga pari nga magapatigayun sang misa.
english: Colada said masses in other churches are often delayed because there are no priests to conduct masses.

text: Ginapanan-aw ni Fr.
english: Fr.

text: Colada ang problema pinansyal bilang isa sa mga rason sa pagnubo sang numero sang mga pamatan-on nga nagasulod sa pagka-pari.
english: Colada cited financial problems as one of the reasons for the decline in the number of young people entering the priesthood.

text: Matandaan nga nagpadulong si Jaro Archbishop Most Rev.
english: It can be recalled that Jaro Archbishop Most Rev.

text: Midyphil Billones D.D. sa Northern Iloilo, particular sa Gigantes Island bangud sa panawagan sang isa ka tumuluo nga hatagan sang pagtamod ang pumuluyo sang Carles, Iloilo bangud halos wala sang pari sa amo nga lugar.
english: Midyphil Billones D.D. in Northern Iloilo, particularly in Gigantes Island due to the call of a believer to give attention to the people of Carles, Iloilo because there is almost no priest in that area.

text: Bangud sini, nagsaulog sang Semana santa si Archbishop Billones sa isla Gigantes, kun sa diin mainit gid ini nga gin-abi-abi kag ginpasalamatan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Because of this, Archbishop Billones celebrated Easter on Gigantes Island, where he was warmly welcomed and thanked by the people.

text: Sa karun, nagahimo sang nagkalain-lain tikang ang Archdiocese of Jaro, ilabi na ang pagpatigayun sang scholarship programs sa mga pamatan-un nga tuyo magsulod sa bokasyon sang pagka-pari agud nga mahatagan ang mga ini sang kahigayunan kag masolosyunan ang naganubo nga numero sang mga kaparian.
english: Currently, the Archdiocese of Jaro is taking various steps, especially the conduct of scholarship programs for young people who intend to enter the vocation of the priesthood in order to give them the opportunity and solve the declining number of priests.

text: Posible nga lima na lamang ka units kada ruta sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) ang magabyahe umpisa subong nga adlaw bangud indi na masarangan sang mga ini ang padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong.
english: It is possible that only five units per route of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) will operate starting today because they can no longer afford the continuous increase in fuel prices.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, chairman sang WVTC, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang pagkalugi sang ila kooperatiba amo man sang mga driver bangud sa nagakatabo nga krisis sa gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, chairman of the WVTC, said the cooperative continues to suffer losses as well as the drivers due to the ongoing fuel crisis.

text: Suno kay Parcon, nagakadugangan ang kabudlayan sang ila operasyon ilabi na kun pigado ang byahe kag magamay ang pasahero nga nagasakay, rason nga mapilitan na lang ang mga ini nga gamayon na lang ang nagabyahe sa ila kooperatiba.
english: According to Parcon, the difficulties of their operation are increasing especially when the flights are poor and the number of passengers is small, which is why they are forced to have fewer passengers in their cooperative.

text: Ginpabutyag man sini nga tubtob subong wala gihapon nakaabot ang ginpangako nga ayuda sang gobyerno kag kaangay nga ginapabungol-bungolan na lamang ang ila pangabay nga dugangan man kuntani ang plete.
english: He also expressed that until now, the promised assistance of the government has not arrived and it seems that their request to increase the fare is being ignored.

text: Dugang pa sini, naga-lab-ot na sa masobra P5,000 ang ila ginagasto sa gasolina kada adlaw, wala pa dala ang sweldo sang mga driver kag iban pa nga operational expenses, rason nga dako ang ila kapierdehan kun indi nila malab-ot ang ila qouta.
english: He added that they already spend more than P5,000 on gasoline per day, not including the salaries of drivers and other operational expenses, which is why they suffer huge losses if they do not reach their quota.

text: Nagapanawagan man ang mga ini sa gobyerno nga hatagan sang bulig ang ila sektor agud malikawan ang mas madamo pa nga unit nga madula sa kalsada kun sa diin mas maapektuhan pa ang mga commuters.
english: They also called on the government to provide assistance to their sector to avoid more units being lost on the road which will further affect the commuters.

text: Naglab-ot na sa 425 gas stations ang nag-untat sa ila negosyo bangud sa nagapadayun nga pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong petrolyosuno sa Philippine National Police subong nga Marso 27, 2026.
english: A total of 425 gas stations have ceased operations due to the continuous increase in the price of petroleum products, according to the Philippine National Police as of March 27, 2026.

text: Ini matapos nga wala pa sa gihapon natapos ang tensyon sa Middle East sa tunga sang United States of America, Israel kag Iran.
english: This comes after tensions in the Middle East between the United States of America, Israel and Iran are still not over.

text: Ginpakigbahin ni PNP Spokesperson Police Brigadier General Randulf Tuaño nga yara lamang sa 387 ang numero sang nagsirado nga mga gasolinahan kahapon nga adlaw, apang nadugangan ini subong sang 38 gasoline stations.
english: PNP Spokesperson Police Brigadier General Randulf Tuaño shared that the number of gas stations that closed yesterday was only 387, but it has now increased to 38 gasoline stations.

text: Suno kay Tuaño, pila diri ang ginreklamo sa mga awtoridad bangud sa hoarding, profiteering, overpricing, trademark violation,kag unfair competition.
english: According to Tuaño, some of them were complained to the authorities for hoarding, profiteering, overpricing, trademark violation, and unfair competition.

text: Sa subong, padayun pa nga nagamonitor ang mga awtoridad ilabi na ang Department of Energy (DOE) nahanungod sa mga presyo kag supply sang mga petroleum products.
english: Meanwhile, the authorities especially the Department of Energy (DOE) are still monitoring the prices and supply of petroleum products.

text: Patay ang walo ka mga tawo samtang pilason naman ang isa ka bata matapos nga narusdak ang isa ka balay sa Kabul, Afghanisytan bangud sa mabaskog nga linog kahapon nga adlaw Abril 3 suno sa National Disaster Management Authority.
english: Eight people were killed and a child injured after a house collapsed in Kabul, Afghanistan, on April 3, according to the National Disaster Management Authority.

text: Base sa German Research Centre for Geosciences, nag-igo ang 5.9 magnitude nga linog sa rehiyon sang Hindu Kish nga may kadalumon nga 177 kilometro.
english: According to the German Research Center for Geosciences, a 5.9 magnitude earthquake struck the Hindu Kish region at a depth of 177 kilometers.

text: Nabatyagan ang mabaskog nga linog sa nagkalain-lain nga lugar kalakip ang Islamabad sa Pakistan, amo man sa Kabul kag New Delhi sa India.
english: Strong earthquakes were felt in various places including Islamabad in Pakistan, as well as Kabul and New Delhi in India.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Afghanistan kilala bilang isa ka pungsod nga vulnerable sa mga kaangay nga hitabo bangud sa geography sini nga madamo sang bukid.
english: Nahibaluan nga ang Afghanistan kilala bilang isa ka pungsod nga vulnerable sa mga kaangay nga hitabo bangud sa geography sini nga madamo sang bukid.

text: Ginabulubanta nga naglab-ot sa 560 ka tawo ang nagakapatay kada tuig bangud sa linog sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: It is estimated that 560 people die each year from earthquakes in the country.

text: Sang Nobyembre 2005, isa ka mabaskog nga linog nga may magnitude 6.3 ang nag-igo sa Afghanistan, nga nagbilin sang indi magnubo nga 27 ka tawo nga napatay bangud naguba ini sang ginatos ka mga kabalayan.
english: In November 2005, a powerful earthquake of magnitude 6.3 struck Afghanistan, leaving at least 27 people dead as it destroyed hundreds of homes.

text: Mahilig ka bala magluto gamit ang non-stick nga pan ukon kalaha?
english: Do you like to cook with a non-stick pan or pan?

text: Base abi mo nga okay lang bisan may gasgas?
english: Do you think it's okay to have a scratch?

text: Pero suno sa mga eksperto, delikado na ina sa lawas!
english: But according to experts, that's dangerous to the body!

text: Pahanumdom ini sa mga nagagamit sang non-stick cookware sa pagluto, bisan isa lang ka gasgas sa pan ukon kalaha, may posibilidad nga magdala sang peligro sa lawas.
english: This is a reminder to those who use non-stick cookware to cook, even a single scratch on a pan or pan, has the potential to pose a health risk.

text: Suno sa pagtuon sang Global Centre for Environmental Remediation, ang gasgas sa Teflon coating sang non-stick pan mahimo magpagwa sang sobra 9,000 ka toxic nano particles.
english: According to a study by the Global Center for Environmental Remediation, a scratch in the Teflon coating of a non-stick pan can release over 9,000 toxic nano particles.

text: Ginsiling pa sang mga researcher halin sa Australia nga bisan isa lang ka luto, posible nga magpagwa sang tubtob 2.3 million ka microplastic kag nanoplastic particles.
english: Researchers from Australia say that even one meal can release up to 2.3 million microplastic and nanoplastic particles.

text: Ini nga mga particles mahimo magtipon sa sulod sang lawas kag magdala sang hormone disruption, sakit sa mga organs, kag posible nga cancer.
english: These particles can build up inside the body and cause hormone disruption, organ pain, and possibly cancer.

text: Gani, bilin sang mga eksperto: likawan na ang daan nga non-stick pan kag maggamit sang alternatibo pareho sang stainless steel, cast iron, ukon ceramic cookware.
english: So, advice from the experts: ditch the old non-stick pan altogether and use an alternative like stainless steel, cast iron, or ceramic cookware.

text: Gin-release na sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang updated fare guide para sa provincial public utility buses.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has released the updated fare guide for provincial public utility buses.

text: Ini kasunod sang bag-o lang gin-aprubahan nga provisional fare increases nga nag-umpisa sang Sabado, Marso 14.
english: This follows the recently approved provisional fare increases that took effect on Saturday, March 14.

text: Ini nga updated guide nagasunod sa order nga gin-isyu sang Marso 13 nga naga-grant sang fare adjustments para sa klasipikasyon sa provincial public utility buses kag agud masiguro nga patas ukon palareho ang implementasyon sang tanan nga provincial bus operators kag sa tanan nga ruta.
english: This updated guide follows an order issued on March 13 granting fare adjustments for the classification of provincial public utility buses and to ensure equal implementation by all provincial bus operators and on all routes.

text: “The approved adjustments have already been reflected and incorporated in the newly issued Fare Guide to ensure uniform implementation across all provincial bus operators and routes,” suno sa statement sang ahensya.
english: “The approved adjustments have already been reflected and incorporated in the newly issued Fare Guide to ensure uniform implementation across all provincial bus operators and routes,” the agency said in a statement.

text: Sa idalom sang updated Fare Guide, ang air-conditioned, super deluxe, kag deluxe provincial buses ang maga-implementar sang provisional fare increase nga P0.35 per kilometer.
english: Under the updated Fare Guide, air-conditioned, super deluxe, and deluxe provincial buses will implement a provisional fare increase of P0.35 per kilometer.

text: Ang luxury buses ang may mas mataas nga adjustment nga P0.45 per kilometer.
english: Luxury buses will have a higher adjustment of P0.45 per kilometer.

text: Sa mga nagasakay naman sa ordinary nga provincial buses, may isaka nga P1.00 sa base fare kag magadugang sang P0.30 sa kada masunod nga kilometro.
english: For those riding ordinary provincial buses, there will be a P1.00 increase in the base fare and an increase of P0.30 for each subsequent kilometer.

text: Natabo ang fare adjustment samtang nagalala ang tensyon sa Middle East kun sa diin apektado naman ang presyuhanay sang gatong sa global market.
english: The fare adjustment comes as tensions in the Middle East escalate, affecting fuel prices in the global market.

text: “The LTFRB advises all provincial bus operators to strictly follow the updated Fare Guide and ensure that the approved fares are properly posted inside their units for the guidance of the riding public,” pahanumdom pa sang ahensya.
english: “The LTFRB advises all provincial bus operators to strictly follow the updated Fare Guide and ensure that the approved fares are properly posted inside their units for the guidance of the riding public,” the agency reminded.

text: Pananglitan may makit-an nga violation ang mga pasahero, mahimo ini i-report sa LTFRB.
english: If passengers find a violation, they can report it to the LTFRB.

text: “Passengers are likewise encouraged to verify the correct fares based on the official Fare Guide and report any violations or overcharging incidents to the LTFRB through its official communication channels,” dugang sang regulatory board.#
english: “Passengers are likewise encouraged to verify the correct fares based on the official Fare Guide and report any violations or overcharging incidents to the LTFRB through its official communication channels,” the regulatory board added.#

text: BY THE WAY, sa mga abyan naton nga luyag maglakat-lakat sa 300-m nga dust road pasulod diri sa Panay News Compound Area kon diin kami nagapuyo, sa adlaw lang kamo anay magduaw diri.
english: BY THE WAY, to our friends who want to walk along the 300-m dust road into the Panay News Compound Area where we live, please visit here during the day.

text: Man, ginpatyan kami diri tal mismo sang tag-iya sang “idle land” pasulod sa amon diri sang suga sa poste sadtong Biyernes.
english: Man, we were killed here by the owner of the “idle land” to bring us here a light pole on Friday.

text: Mga 30 anyos na kami nagapuyo diri sa sulod nga ang mga lote amon tanan nabakal kag napanag-iyahan na.
english: We have been living in here for about 30 years with the plots we have all bought and owned.

text: Napasudlan na kami diri sang MIWD (karon MPIW) water sa kaalwan ni anay Mayor Mansueto Malabor kag MIWD chairman Larry Jamora, kag suga sa poste sa una nga kahigayunan ni anay Kap Aparicio sadtong circa 1995 pa, nga padayon nga ginpasugtan sang una nga tag-iya (Diaz Family).
english: We have been supplied with MIWD (now MPIW) water courtesy of former Mayor Mansueto Malabor and MIWD chairman Larry Jamora, and lights on poles for the first time by former Kap Aparicio circa 1995, which was continuously allowed by the first owner (Diaz Family).

text:
Kag karon, ginpapatyan na kami sang suga diri sa alagyan namon pagwa/pasulod sa main road

sang nagbulos nga tag-iya.
english:
And now, we have the lights turned off here on our way out/in to the main road

of the successor owner.

text: Tani mabuligan kami sang palangga namon nga Mayor Raisa nga mabalik ining amon suga diri, kon diin kon kis-a may gauru-aswang nga mga stalker, kag mahatag na sing lubos ang paggamit sining 300-m nga dust road sa amon.
english: I hope our beloved Mayor Raisa can help us get this light back here, where sometimes there are ghostly stalkers, and give us full use of this 300-m dust road.

text: Pwede, Mayor?
english: Can you, Mayor?

text:
