GIN-CONFIRM ni Acting DOJ Secretary Frederick Vida sadtong Enero 21 nga si DPWH District (Bulacan 1st District) Engr.
english:
***

Acting DOJ Secretary Frederick Vida confirmed on January 21 that DPWH District (Bulacan 1st District) Engr.

text: Henry Alcantara yara na sa idalom sang Witness Protection Program (WPP) kag sa kustodiya na sang Dept.
english: Henry Alcantara is now under the Witness Protection Program (WPP) and in the custody of the Dept.

text: of Justice.
english: of Justice.

text: Nabaton siya sa WPP upod sa duha pa ka DPWH officials kag isa ka contractor sadtong Enero 15 angot sa ginaalegar nga ma-anomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: He was arrested at the WPP along with two other DPWH officials and a contractor on January 15 regarding allegedly anomalous flood control projects.

text: Ang tatlo pa amo sanday DPWH Usec Roberto Bernardo, Engr.
english: The other three are DPWH Usec Roberto Bernardo, Engr.

text: Gerard Opulencia kag contractor Sally Santos.
english: Gerard Opulencia and contractor Sally Santos.

text: Ang maunod nga testimonya sining apat, sunu kay Vida, kinahanglan gid agud ma-expose ang mga “accountable” sa flood control project anomalies, labi na gid ang mas mabangis nga mga buaya, kag ang mga padihot (schemes) nila nga makatudlo sa mga otoridad kon paano matapna kag indi na matabo liwat ang kasubong nga mga corrupt practices.
english: The testimony of these four, according to Vida, is essential to expose those “accountable” for flood control project anomalies, especially the more ferocious crocodiles, and their schemes that can teach the authorities how to prevent and prevent such corrupt practices from happening again.

text: Baylo sa panestigo sining apat sa idalom na sang WPP, sunu kay DOJ Secretary Vida, mapawala man ang ila salabton criminal.
english: In exchange for the punishment of these four who are already under the WPP, according to DOJ Secretary Vida, their criminal responsibility will also be removed.

text:
***

Meantime, na-revoke na sang Professional Regulatory Board of Civil Engineering (PRBCE), sa idalom sang Professional Regulatory Commission (PRC), sadtong Enero 12, 2025 ang professional license ni Engr.
english:
***

Meantime, the Professional Regulatory Board of Civil Engineering (PRBCE), under the Professional Regulatory Commission (PRC), on January 12, 2025, revoked the professional license of Engr.

text: Alcantara bilang Civil Engineer.
english: Alcantara said Civil Engineer.

text: “Found guilty” si Alcantara, sunu sa PRC, sang “gross unprofessional and unethical conduct” bangod sang iya “self-confessed involvement” sa non-existent and substandard” nga flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: Alcantara was found guilty, according to the PRC, of ​​“gross unprofessional and unethical conduct” for his “self-confessed involvement” in non-existent and substandard flood control projects in Bulacan.

text: Na-establisar sang PRBCE nga wala sing pangduha-duha (willfully) nga gin-aprubahan ni Engr.
english: The PRBCE established that it was willfully approved by Engr.

text: Alcantara ang pagbayad para sa sining mga “ghost projects”, isa ka buhat nga naga-constitute sang “severe breach of the Code of Ethics for Civil Engineers” kag “betrayal of public trust,” dugang nga paathag sang PRC.
english: Alcantara requested payment for these “ghost projects”, a practice that constitutes a “severe breach of the Code of Ethics for Civil Engineers” and “betrayal of public trust,” the PRC further explained.

text: Angot diri, na-turnover na gani ni Alcantara sa Dept.
english: In this regard, Alcantara has already turned over to the Dept.

text: Justice ang sobra sa PhP181 ka Milyon bilang una nga kabayaran sang mga PhP300 nga ginbulsa niya nga mga kickback halin sa flood control projects.
english: Justice received more than PhP181 million as initial payment for the PhP300 kickbacks he pocketed from flood control projects.

text:
***

Sa kaso ni Bernardo, gin-expose niya sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee (SBRC) ang pag-areglohanay sa Kamara sang mga kongresista kag mga regional kag district engineers kon ano ang mga “allocable” nga mga proyekto nga natugyan sa DPWH kag kon diin ini natalana sang National Budget nga naaprubahan na sang Presidente.
english:
***

In Bernardo's case, he exposed to the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee (SBRC) the agreement in the House of Representatives and regional and district engineers on what are the “allocable” projects entrusted to the DPWH and where they are scheduled in the National Budget that has already been approved by the President.

text: Kag diri na natabo ang pag-areglohanay kon ano ining mga proyekto kag kon diin ini matupa sunu sa luyag gid sang mga kongresista baylo sa kickback (masami 20-25%) nga mahisugtan kag partidahon sang proponent nga kongresista kag sang nag-otorisar nga DPWH official.
english: And this is where the agreement took place on what these projects are and where they will fall according to the wishes of the congressmen in exchange for a kickback (usually 20-25%) that can be agreed upon and shared by the proposing congressman and the authorizing DPWH official.

text: Ang malain pa kay kon kis-a ma-report pa nga “completed” ining  mga proyekto gali wala ga-existir, ukon ghost project.
english: The worst part is that sometimes these projects are reported as “completed” but they don't exist, or ghost projects.

text: Kag kon trabahuon man, substandard kay indi na kaigu ang galastuhon ikumparar sa orihinal nga pondo.
english: And if it is done, it is substandard because the cost is not enough compared to the original fund.

text:
***

Sa kaso naman ni Engr.
english:
***

In the case of Engr.

text: Gerard Opulencia, nga former DPWH National Capital Region regional director, gin-aku sini ang iya kasal-anan kag nag-turnover sang mga PhP40 ka Milyon nga nagpahapos man sang iya pagsulod sa WPP.
english: Gerard Opulencia, former DPWH National Capital Region regional director, pleaded guilty and turned over about PhP40 million which also facilitated his entry into WPP.

text: Sunu kay DOJ Sec.
english: According to DOJ Sec.

text: Vida, ining PhP40 ka Milyon pauna lang ini nga pagbalik sang mga PhP150 ka Milyon nga nabaton niya nga kickback.
english: Vida, this PhP40 million is just the preliminary return of the PhP150 million he received as kickback.

text: Samtang, si contractor Sally Santos nag-uli man sang mga PhP15 ka Milyon sa Kaban ng Bayan, bilang pauna nga “restitution” sa iya man involvement sa ma-anomaliya nga flood control projects, sunu kay DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez.
english: Meanwhile, contractor Sally Santos also returned about PhP15 million to the Kaban ng Bayan, as initial “restitution” for her involvement in anomalous flood control projects, according to DOJ spokesperson Polo Martinez.

text: Si Santos amo ang tag-iya kag manager sang SYMS Construction Trading.
english: Santos is the owner and manager of SYMS Construction Trading.

text: Gin-admitir ni Santos ang pag-deliver, bilang “overprice” seguro sang mga materyales, sang mga PhP245 ka Million “in cash” sa sulod lang sang isa ka adlaw sa upisina sang DPWH.
english: Santos admitted to delivering, as “overprice” insurance of materials, about PhP245 million “in cash” in just one day to the DPWH office.

text: Ginsiling niya nga, sa kabug-usan, basi naka-deliver siya sa DPWH sang mga PhP1.0 ka Bilyon na sugod sadtong 2022 tubtub sining ulihi lang niya nga pag-deliver sang kwarta sa DPWH.
english: He said that, in total, he may have delivered to the DPWH about PhP1.0 billion since 2022 until his last delivery of money to the DPWH.

text:
***

Samtang si SBRC chairman Panfilo Lacson nagapati nga sobra sa PhP180 ka Bilyon sang public funds ang nawaldas (wasted) sa “ghost projects” sugod sadtong 2016.
english:
***

Meanwhile, SBRC chairman Panfilo Lacson believes that more than PhP180 billion of public funds have been wasted on ghost projects since 2016.

text: Sunu man kay Lacson kag Senate finance committee chair Sherwin Gatchalian, sa 10,000 ka proyekto nga na-review nila, mga 600 gid ang “ghost” ukon “nonexistent” nga mga proyekto./PN
english: Lacson and Senate finance committee chair Sherwin Gatchalian said that out of the 10,000 projects they reviewed, about 600 were ghost or nonexistent projects.

text: Gina-antisipar sang mga deboto ni Señor Sto.
english: The devotees of Señor Sto.

text: Niño ang pagahiwatun nga fluvial procession sa masunod nga Enero 23, 2026.
english: Niño the fluvial procession will be held on January 23, 2026.

text: Bangud diri, ginpasiguro na sang Philippine Coast Guard Iloilo nga preparado na ang ila nga mga personnel kag amo man ang mga barko nga pagagamitun sa nasambit nga aktibidad.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard Iloilo has assured that its personnel and ships will be used for the activity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay ENS.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, ENS.

text: EL (ensen) John Ga, Spokesperson sang PCG Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang BRP Kalanggaman ukon ang 24 meter vessel Fast Patrol Boat sang PCG ang pagakargahan sang imahe ni Señor Santo Ñino.
english: EL (ensen) John Ga, Spokesperson sang PCG Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang BRP Kalanggaman ukon ang 24 meter vessel Fast Patrol Boat sang PCG ang pagakargahan sang imahe ni Señor Santo Ñino.

text: Samtang ang 4-meter fast patrol boat ukon ang BRP Malapascua naman ang magapasakay sang mga tinawo halin sa Parish Church, mga opisyales sang syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Meanwhile, the 4-meter fast patrol boat or BRP Malapascua will carry personnel from the Parish Church, officials of the city and province of Iloilo.

text: May ara naman sang 10 ka mga modernized boats ang para sa mga deboto kun sa diin may ara sang tig duha ka mga assigned personnel sang PCG ang gin-assign agud nga masiguro ang seguridad sang tagsa ka mga deboto.
english: There are 10 modernized boats for the devotees where two assigned personnel of the PCG have been assigned to ensure the security of each devotee.

text: Ginklaro man sang ahensya nga indi pagpatugutan nga magsakay ang mga deboto kun wala ini sang may mapakita nga mga tickets.
english: The agency also clarified that devotees will not be allowed to board without showing tickets.

text: Suno pa kay Ga, may ara sang maga-convoy nga mga Rigid Inflatable Boat inkaso nga may ara sang mga emerhensya sa tunga sang Iloilo river.
english: Ga said there will be convoys of rigid inflatable boats in case of emergencies in the middle of the Iloilo river.

text: Nagsubmit sang supplemental affidavit ang beauty queen kag aktres nga si Michelle Dee batok sa social media personality nga si Xian Gaza suno sa iya legal team, agud nga maghinyo sa International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) sang red notice para sa kay Gaza.
english: Beauty queen and actress Michelle Dee has submitted a supplemental affidavit against social media personality Xian Gaza, according to her legal team, to request a red notice for Gaza from the International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol).

text: Ang Interpol red notice ay isa ka request sa mga law enforcement sa bilog nga kalibutan agud sagapon kag temporary nga arestuhon ang isa ka tawo samtang nagahulat sang extradition ukon iban pa nga mga legal nga proseso.
english: An Interpol red notice is a request to law enforcement around the world to detain and temporarily arrest a person pending extradition or other legal processes.

text: Paathag sang abogado ni Dee nga si Atty. Maggie Abraham-Garduque, kun magbalik si Xian sa Pilipinas kag may existing warrant of arrest na, sarang ini nga arestuhon.
english: Dee's lawyer, Atty. Maggie Abraham-Garduque, if Xian returns to the Philippines and has an existing warrant of arrest, he can be arrested.

text: Kun yara naman ini sa iban nga pungsod, possible ini nga maaresto sang Interpol.
english: If he is in another country, he is likely to be arrested by Interpol.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ang nasambit nga lihok ang maay kaangtanan sa mga post ni Xian sa social media nga ginakabig bilang nilang defamatory kag malicious batok kay Michelle.
english: He added that the move was related to Xian's posts on social media that were considered defamatory and malicious against Michelle.

text: Antes sini, nakabatubn man si Michelle sang subpoena humalin sa National Bureau of Investigation, nga ila man pagasundon.
english: Earlier, Michelle also received a subpoena from the National Bureau of Investigation, which they will also follow.

text: Nagtaas ang tingog ni Senator Loren Legarda matapos sini nabatun ang sabat sang executive branch natuhoy sa gilayun nga pag-abrubar sang senado sa suspension sang excise tax sa gatong.
english: Senator Loren Legarda raised her voice after receiving the executive branch's response regarding the Senate's immediate approval of the suspension of the excise tax on fuel.

text: Suno kay Legarda nga indi klaro ang panindugan sang administrasyon bangud sang nagmandu ang mga ini nga himuon nga “urgent” ang suspension sang excise tax, gilayun ini nga ginpasar sa Senado, apang sang naaprubahan na ini, ginsabat lamang sila sang executive branch sang “we will see”.
english: Legarda said the administration's position is unclear because when they ordered the suspension of the excise tax to be made urgent, it was immediately passed in the Senate, but when it was approved, the executive branch responded with “we will see”.

text: Ginkwestyon man ni Legarda ang pahayag sang pila ka energy officials nga nag-submit na ang mga ini sang mensahe agud nga magpangayo sang dugang nga budget para sa Philippine National Oil Company (PNOC), apang ginpahayag nila nga naka-break ang kongreso rason nga wala ini naaprubahan.
english: Legarda also questioned the statement of some energy officials that they have already submitted a message to request additional budget for the Philippine National Oil Company (PNOC), but they said that Congress broke and that is why it was not approved.

text: Paathag ni Legarda nga daw kaangay ginagamit ini nga rason agud nga indi gilayun masolusyunan ang isyu sa fuel tax kag nagapakita sang indi consistent nga polisa sang administrasyon.
english: Legarda explained that this seems to be used as an excuse to prevent the fuel tax issue from being resolved immediately and shows the inconsistent policy of the administration.

text: Gin-ulan sang nanari-sari nga reaksyon ang video nga naglapta online nga nagapakita sang prusisyon sa Barangay Calvario, Meycauayan, Bulacan kadungan sang Byernes Santo.
english: A video that circulated online showing a procession in Barangay Calvario, Meycauayan, Bulacan during Good Friday has received mixed reactions.

text: Indi ang prusisyon mismo ang ginmuno sang netizens kundi ang voice over.
english: Netizens did not criticize the procession itself but the voice over.

text:
Sa baylo nga may live prayer leader, nagagwa kun pamatian nga ang rosaryo nga ginapatunog sa portable sound system ang gin-generate paagi sa artificial intelligence ukon A.I.

“In 200 meters, turn left, Amen,” kabahin sang komento sa Facebook.
english:
Instead of having a live prayer leader, it appears that the rosary being played on the portable sound system is generated by artificial intelligence or A.I.

“In 200 meters, turn left, Amen,” was part of the Facebook comment.

text:
Sabat sang isa: “*lumabas bigla yung CEO.”

Madamo naman ang nagpahayag nga tinamad kag indi seryoso sa pagpangamuyo ang paggamit sang A.I.

“Hindi tinipid pero tinamad hahaha,” pahayag sang isa samtang may mga nagasiling naman nga daw nagalantaw lang sila sang random reels sa ila feed.
english:
One replied: “*the CEO suddenly came out.”

Many have said that the use of A.I. is lazy and not serious about prayer.

“Not frugal but lazy hahaha,” said one while others said they were just watching random reels on their feed.

text: May mga naham-ot kag nag-share sang videos, samtang madamo naman ang nagpabutyag sang pagkadismaya ilabi na nga parte ini sang Holy Week celebration.
english: Some were shocked and shared videos, while many expressed disappointment especially since it was part of the Holy Week celebration.

text: “Minus 10 kayu sa langit..
english: “Minus 10 trees in heaven..

text: apaka tamad nyu manalangin!,” komento pa sang isa ka netizen.
english: how lazy you are to pray!,” commented one netizen.

text: Ginahulat pa ang statement sang mga opisyal sa Barangay Calvario, Meycauayan, Bulacan agud klaruhon kun naggamit sang pre-recorded, non-human voice kadungan sini nga Catholic tradition.
english: The statement of officials in Barangay Calvario, Meycauayan, Bulacan is still awaited to clarify whether a pre-recorded, non-human voice was used in line with this Catholic tradition.

text: Patay na sang nakit-an ang tatlo ka mga lalaki nga nalumos sa isa ka irigasyon sa Brgy.
english: Three men were found dead after drowning in an irrigation canal in Brgy.

text: Naglabrahan, Guimba, Nueva Ecija kahapon, Lunes Santo.
english: Naglabrahan, Guimba, Nueva Ecija yesterday, Holy Monday.

text: Ginpahayag nga pagkatapos nga nag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon, naligo sa irigasyon ang tatlo ka mag-abyan.
english: After drinking alcohol, the three friends reportedly took a bath in the irrigation system.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, gin-anod ang mga ini bangud sa mabaskog nga daludo sang tubig sa irigasyon.
english: According to reports, they were washed away due to strong waves of water in the irrigation system.

text: Padayon naman nga ginaimbestigahan sang otoridad ang insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Nagpaandam ang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga posible maglab-ot sa P580 ang presyo sang kada kilo sang baboy kun magpadayon pa sa pagtimbuok ang presyo sang gatong.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has warned that the price of pork could reach P580 per kilo if fuel prices continue to rise.

text: Sa Senate hearing, ginpaathag ni Agriculture Assistant Secretary U-Nichols Manalo nga ang gyera sa Middle East mahimo makaapekto man sa gasto sa feeds rason nga mapataas ang farmgate prices sang livestock.
english: In the Senate hearing, Agriculture Assistant Secretary U-Nichols Manalo explained that the war in the Middle East could also affect the cost of feeds causing farmgate prices of livestock to rise.

text: Ginaantisipar man gani suno sa opisyal nga magpanirado na lang anay ang smallholders ukon magpangita anay sang iban nga negosyo.
english: The official said it is anticipated that smallholders will close down or find other businesses.

text: Ginsugid man sini sa upper chamber sang Kongreso ang worst-case scenario.
english: He also told the upper chamber of Congress the worst-case scenario.

text: Kun magpadayon pa ang gyera tubtub sa Agusto kag maglab-ot ang presyo sang langis sa average nga $200 kada bariles, ang posibilidad suno sa ahensya amo nga magadangat man ang retail prices sang local pork ham sa P558.10 per kilo samtang P588.10 per kilo naman ang pork belly.
english: If the war continues until August and the price of oil reaches an average of $200 per barrel, the possibility, according to the agency, is that the retail prices of local pork ham will also reach P558.10 per kilo while pork belly will reach P588.10 per kilo.

text: Kun matabo, 59% ang isaka sini halin sa average retail prices nga na-rekord antes ang gyera nga P350 tubtub P370 per kilo.
english: If it happens, it will be a 59% increase from the average retail prices recorded before the war of P350 to P370 per kilo.

text: Magluwas sa presyo sang baboy, mahimo man magsaka sa P324.64 per kilo ang retail prices sa manok halin sa P200 per kilo nga presyo antes ang gyera.
english: Besides the price of pork, retail prices of chicken could also rise to P324.64 per kilo from the P200 per kilo price before the war.

text: Kun basehan naman ang Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG), posible nga indi na malab-ot ang “worst-case scenario” bangud sang suspensyon sang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo.
english: According to the Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG), it is possible that the “worst-case scenario” will not be achieved due to the suspension of excise tax on petroleum products.

text: Una naman nga ginpaathag ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Earlier, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. explained that

text: nga apektado sang gyera ang presyo sang pagkaon bangud sa pagsaka sa logistics kag input costs ilabi na ang urea-based fertilizer.
english: that the war has affected food prices due to rising logistics and input costs especially urea-based fertilizer.

text:
Ang nagapanguna nga ginakabalak-an sang DA amo ang mga pagpamomba sa Strait of Hormuz nga isa ka importante nga alagyan sang fertilizer supply.#

(Photo: Ryan Baldemor)
english:
The main concern of the DA is the bombings in the Strait of Hormuz which is an important fertilizer supply route.#

(Photo: Ryan Baldemor)

text: Gin-athag ni Ellen Adarna nga wala siya sang plano mag-reconcile sa anay nobyo nga si John Lloyd Cruz kag mas maayo na lang nga mag-updanay sila sa pag-atipan sa ila anak nga si Elias.
english: Ellen Adarna explained that she has no plans to reconcile with her ex-boyfriend John Lloyd Cruz and that it is better for them to take care of their son Elias together.

text: Suno kay Ellen, maayo kag hilway ang co-parenting arrangement kag wala sang gamo.
english: According to Ellen, the co-parenting arrangement was good and peaceful and there was no violence.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang aktres ang child support nga iya nabaton halin kay John Lloyd para sa ila bata nga si Elias.
english: The actress also shared the child support she received from John Lloyd for their son Elias.

text: Ini nga pahayag sang actress ang iya ginpagwa matapos ang mga huring-huring nga liwat nga nagaayuhay ang ila buot ni Cruz.
english: The actress' statement came after rumors that she and Cruz were getting back together.

text: Dugang pa sini nga si John Lloyd ang nagapresentar sa iya nga maghatag sang bulig pinansyal sa kinahanglanon sang iya bata sa actress.
english: He added that John Lloyd was presenting him to provide financial assistance for the needs of his child to the actress.

text: Iginiit ni Iloilo 1st District Representative at dating Department of Health Secretary Janette Garin na walang kaugnayan ang tumataas na kaso ng leptospirosis sa ilang bahagi ng bansa sa mga kontrobersyal na flood control projects.
english: Iloilo 1st District Representative and former Department of Health Secretary Janette Garin stressed that the increasing cases of leptospirosis in some parts of the country have nothing to do with the controversial flood control projects.

text: Pahayag ni Garin na ibang usapin umano ang leptospirosis at maling gawing isyu sa pulitika ang pag-uugnay nito sa flood control projects.
english: Garin said leptospirosis is a different issue and it is wrong to make it a political issue in relation to flood control projects.

text: Giit niya, ang tunay na problema ay ang kakulangan sa maayos na komunikasyon at implementasyon ng mga programang pangkalusugan, gayong may pondo, gamot, at murang prophylaxis tulad ng doxycycline na hindi nagamit nang maayos.
english: He stressed that the real problem is the lack of proper communication and implementation of health programs, lack of funds, drugs, and cheap prophylaxis such as doxycycline that is not used properly.

text: Batay sa datos ng DOH, umabot na sa 1,272 ang naitalang kaso ng leptospirosis mula Hulyo 13 hanggang Agosto 6, kabilang ang 13 nasawi sa San Lazaro Hospital.
english: According to DOH data, 1,272 cases of leptospirosis were recorded from July 13 to August 6, including 13 who were treated at San Lazaro Hospital.

text: Ang sakit ay nakukuha sa ihi ng hayop tulad ng daga na humahalo sa tubig-baha, na nagdudulot ng lagnat, pagsusuka, pananakit ng kalamnan, at matinding sakit ng ulo.
english: The disease is transmitted through the urine of an animal such as a rat that mixes with flood waters, causing fever, vomiting, muscle aches, and severe headaches.

text: Ginkasuhan sang isa ka asawa ang iya nga bana matapos nadiskubre nga kalbo ini kag wig lang ang iya buhok.
english: A wife sued her husband after discovering that he was bald and wearing only a wig.

text: Suno sa tagreklamo nga si Lavika Gupta sang Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, gin-into siya sang iya bana nga si Sanyam Jain kag pamilya sini bangud wala siya ginpahibalo nga kalbo ini antes ang ila kasal sang Enero 2024.
english: According to the complainant Lavika Gupta of Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, she was teased by her husband Sanyam Jain and his family for not informing him that he was bald before their wedding in January 2024.

text: Pahayag ni Lavika, sang yara pa lang sila sadto sa “matchmaking stage”, ginpromisa sa iya ang isa ka lalaki nga manami ang buhok apang ulihi na niya nadiskubre nga kalbo ini.
english: Lavika said that when they were in the matchmaking stage, she was promised a man with nice hair but she later discovered that he was bald.

text: Magluwas sa isyu sa buhok, nabuko man ni Gupta nga peke ang credentials sang bana tuhoy sa iya educational background.
english: Aside from the hair issue, Gupta also alleged that the husband's credentials regarding his educational background were fake.

text: Gin-alegar man sang asawa nga ginsakit siya sang iya bana kag ginpilit nga magpalusot sang marijuana halin sa Thailand pabalik sa India.
english: The wife also alleged that her husband tortured her and forced her to smuggle marijuana from Thailand back to India.

text: Sa subong, desidido ang asawa nga ipapreso ang bana samtang wala pa sang pamatbat nga gindagdag ang korte.
english: At present, the wife is determined to send her husband to jail while the court has not added any explanation.

text: HILWAY NGA PANUGDAON NI MATT NI WENCESLAO “MATT” E.  MATEO JR.
english: FREE SUGGESTION BY MATT BY WENCESLAO “MATT” E. MATEO JR.

text: GINADUSO sadto ni Senador Rodante Marcoleta nga mangin State Witness ang mag-asawa nga Curlee kag Sarah Discaya sa multi-billion flood control project corruption nga nadiskubrihan ni PBBM sa iya 2025 SONA sadtong Hulyo 28, 2025.
english: Senator Rodante Marcoleta proposed that Curlee and Sarah Discaya become State Witnesses in the multi-billion flood control project corruption that PBBM discovered in its 2025 SONA on July 28, 2025.

text: Tungod kuno kay daku ang ila ihibalo sa isyu nga “malversation of public funds” angot sa pagpangayo sang kickback sang mga kongresista kag mga senador sa mga proyekto nga nadaug sa bidding sang at least mga kompaniya nila sa Bulacan.
english: Because they are well aware of the issue of “malversation of public funds” regarding the demand for kickbacks by congressmen and senators for projects won in the bidding of at least their companies in Bulacan.

text: May siyam (9) ka kompaniya ang mga Discaya nga nakakuha sang flood control project sang gobyerno sa bug-os nga pungsod, sunu sa 2025 SONA ni PBBM.
english: Discaya has nine (9) companies that have won government flood control projects nationwide, according to PBBM's 2025 SONA.

text: Pero, wala ini ginpasugtan sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee sa pagpamuno ni Senador Ping Lacson.
english: However, the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee headed by Senator Ping Lacson did not approve it.

text: Dira sa Bulacan, ginatudlo ang mga kompaniya nila nga nagapanguna nga bulugasan sang mga pulitiko kag kasosyo nga mga DPWH officials sa ila ginapangayo nga mga kickback.
english: In Bulacan, their companies are being pointed out as the main targets of politicians and partners of DPWH officials in their demands for kickbacks.

text: Kag tungod sina indi sila maka-qualify mangin State Winess, sunu kay Lacson, kay sunu sa kasuguan dapat “least guilty” sila ikumparar sa iban nga mga akusado.
english: And because of that they cannot qualify to be State Winess, according to Lacson, because according to the law they must be “least guilty” compared to other defendants.

text: Kon maaprubahan ang ila aplikasyon agud mangin State Witness, malibre ang mag-asawa nga Discaya sa kon ano man nga akusasyon batok sa ila, nga indi mapasugtan ni Lacson.
english: If their application to become State Witnesses is approved, the Discayas will be free from any charges against them, which Lacson will not allow.

text: Nadiskubrihan man ni Lacson nga kliyente gali sang asawa ni Marcoleta ang mga Discaya sa insurance bond sang ila mga proyekto, nga gapahuyang pa gid sang posiblidad nga mabaton sila nga State Witness.
english: Lacson also discovered that the Discayas were actually clients of Marcoleta's wife in the insurance bond of their projects, which further weakened the possibility of them being accepted as State Witnesses.

text: Samtang, isa sa mga gina-konsiderar sang Ombudsman ang posibilidad nga mangin State Witness si DPWH 1st District (Bulacan) Engr.
english: Meanwhile, one of the Ombudsman's considerations is the possibility of DPWH 1st District (Bulacan) Engr.

text: Henry Alcantara tungod kay gin-aku niya ang pagkalamita niya sa “malversation of public funds” kag gin-boluntad ang pagbalik sang mga P181 ka Milyon nga kickback nga nabaton man niya upod sa mga akusado nga mga kongresista kag mga senador nga nagpatigayon sang mga flood control project sa 1st District sang Bulacan.
english: Henry Alcantara because he admitted his involvement in “malversation of public funds” and volunteered the return of about P181 million kickback that he also received along with the accused congressmen and senators who conducted flood control projects in the 1st District of Bulacan.

text: Nahatagan man siya sang iya ginapangayo nga proteksyon para sa iya pamilya.
english: He was also granted the protection he sought for his family.

text: Pero ano ining balita nga kuno nagbaliswa siya kag ginpanginwala ang iya sinumpaan nga deklarasyon sa Senate BRC nga nakaabot sa igdulungog ni Senador Ping Lacson, nga tsirman sang Senate BRC?
english: But what about this news that he allegedly turned around and denied his sworn declaration to the Senate BRC that reached the ears of Senator Ping Lacson, the chairman of the Senate BRC?

text: Kon matuod, ginpaandaman gid gani ni Lacson si Alcantara sa mahimo niya atubangon nga mga akusasyon bangod sini, katulad sang “perjury” kon diin pwede siya makulong tubtub anom (6) ka tuig.
english: If true, Lacson even warned Alcantara of the charges he could face because of this, such as “perjury” where he could be imprisoned for up to six (6) years.

text: Ang balita gasiling nga gin-deny na ni Alcantara ang iya involvement sa ghost flood control projects kag gintudlo ang iya mga subordinate nga sanday Engr.
english: The news says that Alcantara has denied his involvement in ghost flood control projects and pointed to his subordinates Engr.

text: Brice Hernandez kag Engr.
english: Brice Hernandez and Engr.

text: Jaypee Mendoza nga amo ang nag-engineer sining mga anomaliya nga transaksyon kon diin wala siya kuno kahilabtanan.
english: Jaypee Mendoza who engineered these anomalous transactions where he was allegedly not involved.

text: Kon nahimo ini ni Alcantara, indi ayhan kay nanalaw na siya sa sige pamahog sa iya sang mga poderoso nga na-involved sa anomaliya?
english: If Alcantara did this, isn't it because he is tired of the constant threats from the powerful involved in the anomaly?

text: Posible.
english: Possible.

text: Problema lang kay basi mag-backfire pa ini sa iya katulad sang ginapaandam ni Lacson batok sa iya.
english: The problem is that it might backfire on him like Lacson warned against him.

text: Sining ulihi ugaling, ginpanginwala ini sang iya abogado.
english: Later however, his lawyer denied it.

text: Ang Ombudsman nag-confirm man nga wala sila sing nabaton sang kasubong nga recantation nga gin-sumitir ni Alcantara sa Ombudsman.
english: The Ombudsman also confirmed that they have not received any such recantation that Alcantara submitted to the Ombudsman.

text:
***

Sadtong hearing sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee sang Sept.
english:
***

During the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee hearing on Sept.

text: 23, 2025, gin-akusar ni Alcantara sanday retired DPWH Usec.
english: 23, 2025, Alcantara accused retired DPWH Usec.

text: Roberto Bernardo, Sen.
english: Roberto Bernardo, Sen.

text: Jinggoy Estrada, Sen.
english: Jinggoy Estrada, Sen.

text: Joel Villanueva, kag Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.
english: Joel Villanueva, and Ako Bicol Party-list Rep.

text: Zaldy Co, lakip na si former Senator Bong Revilla, bilang tagpatigayon (proponents) sang ma-anomaliya nga flood control project.
english: Zaldy Co, including former Senator Bong Revilla, as proponents of the anomalous flood control project.

text: Gin-claim niya nga si Bernardo, bilang iya “boss”, nag-release sang ginatos ka milyon ka pesos nga pondo para sa sining mga proyekto, nga 25% sini nagkadto, among others, kay Estrada kag Villanueva.
english: He claimed that Bernardo, as his “boss”, released hundreds of millions of pesos in funds for these projects, of which 25% went, among others, to Estrada and Villanueva.

text: Si Estrada kag si Villanueva ginlamita man gani ni DPWH Engr.
english: Estrada and Villanueva were also criticized by DPWH Engr.

text: Nalutos ang 43-anyos nga Pinoy boxing legend nga si Nonito ‘The Filipino Flash’ Donaire sa kamot sang Japanese rising star nga si Riku Masuda sa WBA bantamweight title eliminator sa Yokohama, Japan.
english: 43-year-old Pinoy boxing legend Nonito 'The Filipino Flash' Donaire lost to Japanese rising star Riku Masuda in the WBA bantamweight title eliminator in Yokohama, Japan.

text: Apisar puno sang kumpyansa nga nagsaka sa ring ang four-division champion, nagapabatyag na ang edad sini.
english: Although the four-division champion stepped into the ring full of confidence, his age is already showing.

text: Natumba ini sa ika-pito nga round paagi sa straight left sang Japanese boxer.
english: He was knocked out in the seventh round by a straight left from the Japanese boxer.

text: Sa 1:12 mark sang ika-walo nga round, ginpa-untat na ang hampang.
english: At the 1:12 mark of the eighth round, the match was stopped.

text: Mas manubo si Donaire sa tatlo ka mga scorecard sang gin-untat ang amo nga sambuwa.
english: Donaire was down on three scorecards when that fight was stopped.

text: Pananglitan nagdaog si Donaire, mahatagan kuntani siya sang kahigayunan nga makasaka sa boxing ring para sa world title.
english: If Donaire had won, he would have been given the opportunity to step into the boxing ring for the world title.

text: Ini na ang pang-apat nga tion nga nalutos si Donaire sa iya lima ka ulihi nga hampang, lakip na ang second round technical knockout batok kay undisputed bantamweight champion Naoya Inoue sa ila rematch sang 2022.
english: This is the fourth time Donaire has lost his last five fights, including a second round technical knockout against undisputed bantamweight champion Naoya Inoue in their 2022 rematch.

text: Gina-uyatan ni Donaire ang 43-10 (28 KOs) nga record.
english: Donaire holds a 43-10 (28 KOs) record.

text: Kilala anay ini bilang pound-for-pound fighter sang 2010s kag ginkilala nga Fighter of the Year sang 2012.
english: He was first known as a pound-for-pound fighter in the 2010s and was named Fighter of the Year in 2012.

text: Nakahimo siya sang rekord bilang pinakatigulang nga bantamweight world champion sang Mayo 2021 sa edad nga 38-anyos sang gintumba sini si Nordine Oubaali sa ikaapat nga round agud nga makuha ang WBC title.
english: He set a record as the oldest bantamweight world champion in May 2021 at the age of 38-years-old when he knocked out Nordine Oubaali in the fourth round to win the WBC title.

text: Na-retain sini amo ang amo nga titulo paagi sa isa pa ka fourth-round knockout batok sa isa pa ka Pinoy boxer nga si Raymart Gaballo pito ka bulan ang makaligad sa iya hampang kay Oubaali.
english: He retained the title with another fourth-round knockout against another Filipino boxer, Raymart Gaballo, seven months later in his match against Oubaali.

text: Tungaon pa sang operator kag driver sang tricycle ang P5,000 nga cash assistance nga ginhatag sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) subong nga adlaw, Abril 8.
english: The operator and driver of the tricycle will divide the P5,000 cash assistance given by the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) today, April 8.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Carlo Edis, operator sang Tricycle driver, iya ginpahayag nga ini nga cash assistance dako nga bulig sa ila nga operators amo man sa ila nga mga drivers.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Carlo Edis, operator of the tricycle driver, said that this cash assistance is a big help to their operators as well as their drivers.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nakadepende sa ila nga mga operator kun pila ang ila igahatag nga katunga sang cash assistance sa ila nga mga drivers.
english: He also said that it is up to their operators how much they will give half of the cash assistance to their drivers.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga bangud sa mabudlay nga sitwasyon sa karon iya na lang ginaparentahan sang 130 pesos ang iya nga tricycle kag kun kaisa ginapasugtan na lang sini nga katunga na lang anay ang igabayad sang iya driver sa iya.
english: He said that due to the difficult situation, he only rents his tricycle for 130 pesos and sometimes he allows his driver to pay him half.

text: Dugang pa sini nga tuman ka dako ang deperensya sang kita sa karon bangud nga nagmahal na ang plete kag ang iban nga pasahero nagalakat na lang rason nga sila gid ang dako nga naapektuhan.
english: He added that the difference in income is very large now because the fare has increased and some passengers are walking alone, which is why they are the biggest affected.

text: Nagalaum ang pila ka mga transport cooperative nga nagpatigayun sang transport holiday kahapon nga adlaw sang Lunes, nga nabatian na sang gobyerno ang ila nga kawsa.
english: Some transport cooperatives that held a transport holiday yesterday Monday hope that the government has heard their cause.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) Chairman Reymundo “Boyet” Parcon, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang ila nga pagsalig sa karun, nga mapatuman na ang fare hike sa tagsa ka mga Public Utility Vehicles (PUVs), agud makapiyan-piyan sa ila gastos sa matag-adlaw nga pagbyahe, ilabi na subong nga nagataas ang presyo sang gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC) Chairman Reymundo “Boyet” Parcon said they are confident that the fare hike will be implemented in each Public Utility Vehicles (PUVs) to cover their daily transportation costs as fuel prices rise.

text: Dugang pa ni Parcon nga ila gid nahangpan ang wala pag-upod sang pila ka mga kooperatiba sa ila nga transport strike, bangud man sa pigado nga sitwasyon sang tagsa ka mga PUV drivers subong nga tyempo.
english: Parcon added that they understand the absence of some cooperatives in their transport strike, due to the poor situation of each PUV drivers at the moment.

text: Ginapaabot man sang mga transport cooperatives nga mahatag na sa ila sa masunod nga semana ang ayuda nga gin-promisa sa ila sang gobyerno.
english: The transport cooperatives are also expecting to receive the assistance promised by the government next week.

text: Gin-veto sang Russia kag China ang resolution sa United Nations Security Council (UNSC) nga nagatuyo kuntani nga proteksyunan ang commercial shipping ukon ang mga barko nga nagalabay sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Russia and China vetoed a resolution in the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) that would have aimed to protect commercial shipping or ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ginduso sang Bahrain ang amo nga resolusyon.
english: Bahrain proposed such a resolution.

text: 11 sa 15 ka mga myembro sang council ang nagboto-pabor kag duha naman ang nag-abstain.
english: 11 of the 15 council members voted in favor and two abstained.

text: Bangud pareho nga permanent members sang UN Security Council ang Russia kag China, nagakahulugan ini nga napaslawan nga makapasar ang resolution apisar pila pa ang boto nga nakuha gikan sa iban nga mga myembro.
english: Because both Russia and China are permanent members of the UN Security Council, this means that the resolution failed to pass despite several votes obtained from other members.

text: Suno sa Russia kag China, biased ukon indi patas para sa Iran ang amo nga tikang.
english: Russia and China say the move is biased or unfair to Iran.

text: Sa amo kuntani nga resolusyon, ginaduso nga mag-koordinar ang apektado nga mga nasyon agud masiguro ang safety kag ang seguridad sang navigation sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: The resolution proposes that the affected countries coordinate to ensure the safety and security of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: “The Council failed to shoulder its responsibility in relation to an illegal conduct that requires decisive action with no delay,” suno kay Bahraini Foreign Minister Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani kasunod sang pagbinotohay.
english: “The Council failed to shoulder its responsibility in relation to an illegal conduct that requires decisive action with no delay,” Bahraini Foreign Minister Abdullatif bin Rashid Al Zayani said following the vote.

text: “Failing to adopt this resolution sends the wrong signal to the world, to the peoples of the world, the signal that the threat to international waterways can pass without any decisive action by the international organization responsible for the maintenance of international peace and security,” dugang sini sa statement nga gin-publish sa website sang United Nations.
english: “Failing to adopt this resolution sends the wrong signal to the world, to the peoples of the world, the signal that the threat to international waterways can pass without any decisive action by the international organization responsible for the maintenance of international peace and security,” it added in a statement published on the United Nations website.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang lima ka pungsod sa UNSC nga permanent members amo ang China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, kag the United States nga palareho nga may right of veto sa ano man nga resolution ukon decision.
english: It is known that the five countries in the UNSC that are permanent members are China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States which both have the right of veto on any resolution or decision.

text: Ini nga 10 non-permanent members ang gina-eleher sang UN General Assembly kag naga-serbe para sa two-year terms.
english: These 10 non-permanent members are elected by the UN General Assembly and serve for two-year terms.

text: Nagpanglakaak ang presyo sang langis sa kalibutan halin sang ginbalabagan sang Iran ang amo nga Strait bangud didto nagaagi ang one fifth sang global oil kag liquefied natural gas.
english: World oil prices have soared since Iran blocked the strait, which carries one fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas.

text: Sa bag-o nga development sini nga aga, nagsugot na ang Iran nga makalabay ang mga barko sa Strait of Hormuz sa sulod sang duha ka semana sa kondisyon nga may koordinasyon sa ila armed forces.
english: In a new development this morning, Iran has agreed to allow ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz for two weeks on condition that there is coordination with its armed forces.

text: Ang permiso halin sa Iran ang kasunod sang pagpasugot man sini sa duha ka semana nga ceasefire sa US.#
english: The permit from Iran follows its agreement to a two-week ceasefire with the US.

text: Anom ka mga drivers sa Western Visayas ang nagpositibo sa drug test matapos ang ginpatigayon nga Oplan Harabas sang Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) 6 sa nanuhay-tuhay nga terminals sa Western Visayas, kahapon, Marso 30.
english: Six drivers in Western Visayas tested positive for drugs after the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) 6 conducted Oplan Harabas in various terminals in Western Visayas, yesterday, March 30.

text: Base sa record sang ahensya, duha ang nagpositibo sa Pueblo de Panay Integrated Transport Terminal, Capiz; duha ang nagpositibo sa Culasi Ceres Terminal sa Antique; isa man sa San Jose de Buenavista Terminal, Antique; kag isa sa City Mall Terminal, Kalibo, Aklan.
english: Based on the agency's records, two tested positive in Pueblo de Panay Integrated Transport Terminal, Capiz; two tested positive at Culasi Ceres Terminal in Antique; one also in San Jose de Buenavista Terminal, Antique; and one at City Mall Terminal, Kalibo, Aklan.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ma.

text: Graziella Tanaleon, spokesperson sang PDEA 6, iya ginpahayag nga kabahin ang surprise drug test sang Oplan Harabas nga programa sang ahensya kun sa diin ila ginapasiguro nga wala nagagamit sang iligal nga droga ang mga nagatarabho sa transport sector.
english: Graziella Tanaleon, spokesperson of PDEA 6, said the surprise drug test is part of the agency's Oplan Harabas program where they ensure that those working in the transport sector are not using illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay Tanaleon, 822 tanan ang ginpaidalom sa nasambit nga drug test kun sa diin 761 diri amo ang drivers kag 61 naman ang kundoktor.
english: According to Tanaleon, a total of 822 people were subjected to the drug test, of which 761 were drivers and 61 were conductors.

text: Pahayag pa ni Tanaleon, magapaidalom pa ang anom sa confirmatory test, apang nahibaluan nga ginkumpiskar na sang Land Transportation Office ang ila nga mga lisensya matapos nga nagpositibo kag temporaryo man nga ginpauntat ang ila nga byahe samtang wala pa ang mga ini nagnegatibo sa confirmatory test.
english: Tanaleon said the six will undergo confirmatory tests, but it is known that the Land Transportation Office has already confiscated their licenses after they tested positive and temporarily suspended their flights while they have not yet tested negative.

text: Naglumpat sa dagat halin sa ginasakyan sini nga fiber boat gikan sa Guimaras ang isa ka babaye nga pasahero kaina sang kaagahon.
english: A female passenger jumped into the sea from her fiber boat from Guimaras this morning.

english: The victim was identified as alias “Edna” resident of Carig-on, Buenavista.

english: According to reports, he was suffering from a nervous breakdown.

english: According to Bombo Radyo's investigation, the passenger had just left the fiber boat from the port in Buenavista, Guimaras to Parola Wharf when he jumped.

english: He was immediately rescued by the boat captain.

text: Handa ang China nga magbulig sa Russia sa United Nations Security Council (UNSC) agud nga mapahagan-hagan ang tensyon sa Middle East.
english: China is ready to help Russia in the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) in order to ease tensions in the Middle East.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi kay Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov sa ila pag-istoryahanay sa telepono.
english: This was revealed by Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov in a telephone conversation.

text: Suno kay Wang, kinahanglan ang ceasefire sa labing-madali nga tion agud masolbar na ang problema sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: Wang said a ceasefire is needed as soon as possible to resolve the Strait of Hormuz crisis.

text: Gindugang sini nga masami gid nga naga-upod ang China sa pagduso sang mga kawsa sang political settlement sa mga mainit nga isyu paagi sa dayalogo kag mga negosasyon.
english: He added that China very often joins in pushing the causes of political settlement on hot issues through dialogue and negotiations.

text: Natabo ang pag-istoryahanay sang duha ka opisyal sang Russia kag China antes ang botohay sa UNSC sa masunod nga semana.
english: The talks between the two Russian and Chinese officials took place ahead of the UNSC vote next week.

text: Botohan ang resolution sang Bahrain nga nagatuyo nga proteksyunan ang commercial shipping sa sulod kag sa palibot sang Strait of Hormuz.
english: Bahrain’s resolution aimed at protecting commercial shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz will be voted on.

text: Pareho nga permanent members sang UN Security Council ang China kag ang Russia.
english: Both China and Russia are permanent members of the UN Security Council.

text:

“Satisfaction was expressed at the coincidence in Russia’s and China’s approaches on most issues on the global agenda, including the situation around Iran, related to the unprovoked aggression of the US and Israel against that country,” suno sa statement.
english:
The Russian Foreign Ministry earlier issued a statement saying it discussed with Chinese officials ways to agree on a ceasefire and conduct a “political-diplomatic dialogue.”

“Satisfaction was expressed at the coincidence in Russia’s and China’s approaches on most issues on the global agenda, including the situation around Iran, related to the unprovoked aggression of the US and Israel against that country,” according to the statement.

text: SALAMAT SA DIYOS kay natuman gid man ang handom ko sadto nga may isa ka abogado sa amon pamilya sang malakip ang anak ko nga si Jowenna sa listahan sang mga nakapasar sa 2025 bar exam nga ginpagwa sang Korte Suprema sining ulihi lang sang Enero.
english: THANK GOD that my dream of having a lawyer in our family came true when my daughter Jowenna was included in the list of those who passed the 2025 bar exam released by the Supreme Court in late January.

text: Kulang na lang ang pagsumpa (oathtaking) agud formal na ang pagkilala sa iya bilang abogado, samtang gatrabaho bilang Certified Public Accountant (CPA) sa Commission on Audit (COA).
english: The oathtaking is enough to formally recognize him as a lawyer, while working as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) at the Commission on Audit (COA).

english: CONGRATULATIONS SON!

text: Q. Abeto–Mirasol sa Mandurriao, Siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: Q. Abeto–Sunflower in Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text:
***

Ang pagka-abogado sang anak ko nga si Wen nangin daku gid ini nga bugal sang amon pamilya tungod  gaishanon gid lang siya nga abogado sa amon pamilya.
english:
***

My son Wen's lawyership has become a great pride for our family because he is the only gaishanon lawyer in our family.

text: Sa amon pamilya, luas kay Wen kag manghod niya nga si Len nga public school teacher, ang amon pamilya may madamo na nga mga manunudlo, school director, school superintendent, mga nars kag health workers, piano teacher, piloto, doktor, mechanical engineer, chief marine engineer kag ship captains sa international shipping, kag ako nga nangin manunudlo man kag gaisahanon nga journalist sa amon pamilya.
english: In our family, apart from Wen and his brother Len who are public school teachers, our family has many teachers, school directors, school superintendents, nurses and health workers, piano teachers, pilots, doctors, mechanical engineers, chief marine engineers and ship captains in international shipping, and I became a teacher and journalist in our family.

text:
***

Second year na ako sa Law sa anay University of Iloilo sang gin-deklarar ni anay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english:
***

I was in my second year of Law at the former University of Iloilo when former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: ang Martial Law sadtong 1972.
english: the Martial Law in 1972.

text: Hinadlukan ang akon iloy sa kon ano ang matabo sa akon tungod padayon ako na-link sadto sa hublag panghimakas sang mga estudyante sa amon pagtulod sang Student Power batok sa wala konsyensya nga gobyerno.
english: My mother was afraid of what would happen to me because I was still linked to the student struggle in our push for Student Power against the unconscionable government.

text: Presidente ako sadto sang Iloilo College Editors’ Guild kag co-chairman sang isa ka Regional Student Group upod kay German Gonzales nga presidente sang UP-Iloilo Student Council.
english: I was then president of the Iloilo College Editors’ Guild and co-chairman of a Regional Student Group with German Gonzales who is president of the UP-Iloilo Student Council.

text: Sa pag-deklarar sang martial law, Senate President ako sang UI Student Republic samtang Pol-Sci representative si German sa iya pagsaylo halin sa UP-Iloilo.
english: When martial law was declared, I was the Senate President of the UI Student Republic while German was the Pol-Sci representative on his transfer from UP-Iloilo.

text: Labi na gid nahadlukan ang amon iloy sang nadakpan na si German kag si Ed Peñaredondo sang isa ka progresibo nga grupo kag dayon nahunong sa stockade sang Camp Delgado.
english: Our mother was especially frightened when German and Ed Peñaredondo were arrested by a progressive group and then detained in the stockade of Camp Delgado.

text: Gani, ginpatapok ako sang amon iloy sa isa ka fisherman’s barangay sa Guimaras nga nahigot sa obligasyon nga magtatap sang diutay namon nga pangabuhian didto.
english: So, our mother sent me to a fisherman’s barangay in Guimaras bound by the obligation to take care of our meager livelihood there.

text: Wala ako makabalidad sa luyag sang amon iloy  tungod malubha ang iya pagmasakit.
english: I could not comply with our mother's wishes because she was seriously ill.

text: In fact, bedridden siya sa sulod sang anom ka tuig bag-o nagtaliwan sadtong 1979 kon san-o nagbalik na ako sa pagpuyo sa siyudad.
english: In fact, he was bedridden for six years before he died in 1979 when I returned to live in the city.

text: Sa pagdaug na sang Edsa Revolution nangin mga konsehal na sanday German, nga nagtaliwan na, kag Ed sa Siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: With the victory of the Edsa Revolution, German, who has passed away, and Ed became councilors in Iloilo City.

text: Nag-abogado anay si Ed bag-o magsulod sa pulitika.
english: Ed was a lawyer before entering politics.

text: Ako nagpatupling sa media work sa radyo kag sang ulihi sa pamantalaan lokal tubtub nangin editor-in-chief sang duha ka pamantalaan lokal.
english: I dabbled in media work on the radio and later in the local newspaper until I became editor-in-chief of two local newspapers.

text: Nag-retiro ako nga na-dismiss ang mga 30 ka libel cases bilang reporter, kolumnista kag editor-in-chief upod ang nangin editor-in-chief man nga si Alex Vidal.
english: I retired having dismissed about 30 libel cases as a reporter, columnist and editor-in-chief with then-editor-in-chief Alex Vidal.

text: Na-base karon si Alex sa United States bilang health worker samtang gasulat gihapon bilang kolumnista sa isa ka lokal nga pamantalaan (indi Panay News) diri sa Siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: Alex is now based in the United States as a health worker while still writing as a columnist for a local newspaper (not Panay News) here in Iloilo City.

text: Tungod sa gamay ko nga SSS pension, nagtilaw ako magsulat liwat, this  time sa isa ka Europe-based bi-monthly magazine – ang Roots & Wings nga ginadumalahan sang mag-utod nga Rachel Gaje-Hansen bilang ed-in-chief kag Luz Gaje-Bergersen bilang associate editor, nga naga-existir tubtub subong nga mga 15 anyos na.
english: Thanks to my small SSS pension, I tried writing again, this time in a Europe-based bi-monthly magazine – Roots & Wings run by sisters Rachel Gaje-Hansen as ed-in-chief and Luz Gaje-Bergersen as associate editor, which has been in existence for about 15 years.

text: Taga-Iloilo man ining duha.
english: These two are also from Iloilo.

text: Naka-contribute ako diri sang duha ka artikulo – ang isa parti sa Dinagyang kag ang isa parti sa isa ka Guimaras tourist spot.
english: I have contributed two articles here – one about Dinagyang and the other about a Guimaras tourist spot.

text: Sa kada isa sini nakabaton ako sing US$100, ukon mga PhP4,500 sa tion nga ato, katulad sang ginahatag man sang mga foreign magazine, kasubong sang Readers’ Digest, sa mga mapuslanon nga mga artikulo.
english: For each of these I received US$100, or about PhP4,500 at the time, similar to what foreign magazines, such as Readers' Digest, also give for useful articles.

text: Wala na ako makapadayon sa pagsulat sa R&W sang na-mild stroke ako.
english: I was unable to continue writing at R&W when I had a mild stroke.

text: Apang wala ako nadulaan sang paglaum.
english: But I did not lose hope.

text: Sa pag-recover ko na, naga-contribute na gid lang ako sang kon ano nga masulat nga mabungahon sa lokal nga mga pamantalaan.
english: When I recovered, I was able to contribute what I could write productively to the local newspapers.

text: Subong gani, gasulat ako sang akon weekly column diri sa Panay News./PN
english: So, I'm writing my weekly column here in Panay News./PN

text: Nagtaliwan na si Duenas Vice Mayor Aimee Paz Lamasan matapos ginpahayag nga aksidente nga natiruhan sini ang iya kaugalingon.
english: Duenas Vice Mayor Aimee Paz Lamasan has passed away after she allegedly accidentally stabbed herself.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pangga Lamasan Piccio, Former Vice Mayor sang Duenas kag tiya sang bise alcalde, ginkumpirar sini ang kamatayon ni Lamasan kun sa diin tuman gid ang kasubo nga ila nabatyagan sang nagtaliwan ang nasambit nga bise alcalde.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pangga Lamasan Piccio, former vice mayor of Duenas and aunt of the vice mayor, confirmed the death of Lamasan and said they were very sad when the vice mayor passed away.

text: Madumduman nga natabo ang insidente sang Disyembre 30 samtang ginabutang ni Lamasan ang pusil sa iya nga bag, apang gulpi lang ini nga naglupok rason nga naigo ang iya tiyan.
english: The incident occurred on December 30 while Lamasan was putting the gun in his bag, but it suddenly exploded, hitting him in the stomach.

english: Queen of All Media Kris Aquino is now preparing for one of her most difficult journeys in her ongoing treatment for her autoimmune disease.

text: Ginpakigbahin sini sa iya social media ang ini nga balita pila ka adlaw matapos ang iya ika-55 nga kaadlawan.
english: She shared this news on her social media a few days after her 55th birthday.

text: Suno kay Kris, apisar nga indi sini mahambal pa ang matuod sini nga sitwasyon sa iya ikaayong lawas apang kinahanglan sini nga mangin maisog.
english: According to Kris, although she cannot tell the truth about her health situation, she needs to be brave.

text: Gina-look forward man sini nga maka-abot sa 68 anyos ang iya edad nga suno pa sa iya isa sa pinakamanami nga kagustuhan niya sa iya kabuhi.
english: He also looks forward to reaching the age of 68 which he said is one of the best wishes of his life.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini nga maga-host ini sa isa ka home-tour sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: He also shared that he will be hosting a home-tour in the coming days.

text: Nahibaluan nga madugay na nga nagapakigbato si Kris sa pila ka mga autoimmune disease, apang permi man ini nagalaom sa iya pag-ayo.
english: It is known that Kris has been battling several autoimmune diseases for a long time, but she has also always been hopeful about her recovery.

english: The actress-host is currently in the hospital for six weeks due to her surgery.

english: She also thanked her ex-boyfriend, Dr. Mike Padlan for helping him on his journey to recover from such a disease.

text: Ginpanugyan sang Department of Health (DOH) nga yara sa peligro ang masunod nga henerasyon sang kabataan sa Pilipinas bangud sang padayon nga pagsaka sang kaso sang Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), nga posible maglaton sa krisis kun indi maagapan.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) has advised that the next generation of children in the Philippines is at risk due to the continuous increase in cases of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), which could lead to a crisis if not addressed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Loyd Brendan Norella, HIV Program Manager sang Family Planning Organization of the Philippines (FPOP), iya ginpahayag nga bisan wala pa man nalab-ot ang national threshold sang kaso, ang pagdamo sang HIV infections sa mga vulnerable nga sektor, partikular sa mga naga-edad 15 tubtob 25, isa ka daku nga problema nga kinahanglan tutukan subong pa lang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Loyd Brendan Norella, HIV Program Manager of the Family Planning Organization of the Philippines (FPOP), said that although the national threshold of cases has not been reached, the increase in HIV infections in vulnerable sectors, particularly those aged 15 to 25, is a major problem that needs to be addressed right now.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Norella sa ginpatigayon nga HIV Town Hall nga padayon nga ginakabig nga problema ang kakulang sa Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE), limitado nga akses sa contraceptives, kag ang stigma nga naga-pabilin sa komunidad.
english: Norella also revealed at the HIV Town Hall that the lack of Comprehensive Sexuality Education (CSE), limited access to contraceptives, and the stigma that remains in the community continue to be a problem.

text: Ini nga mga kabudlayan, suno sa iya, nagapugong sa mga kabataan nga makabaton sang insakto nga impormasyon kag proteksyon kontra sa HIV.
english: These difficulties, he said, prevent children from receiving accurate information and protection against HIV.

text: Base sa datos sang DOH, naglab-ot sa 57 na ka bag-o nga kaso sang HIV ang narehistro kada adlaw.
english: Based on DOH data, 57 new HIV cases are registered every day.

text: Suno sa AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) Philippines, nagsaka na sa 500% ang kaso sa mga pamatan-on sa sulod lang sang isa ka tuig.
english: According to the AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) Philippines, the number of cases among young people has increased by 500% in just one year.

text: Gani padayon ang panawagan sang AHF sa gobyerno nga magpagwa sang Executive Order nga magadeklara sang HIV bilang public health emergency sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: AHF therefore continues to call on the government to issue an Executive Order declaring HIV as a public health emergency nationwide.

text: Ginpunto man sang AHF nga kun padayon ang pagbalabag sa condom distribution, posible gid nga ang kabataan subong ang mangin biktima kag ang ila palaabuton nga kabuhi ang maapektuhan.
english: The AHF also pointed out that if the condom distribution continues to be blocked, it is possible that children today will become victims and their future lives will be affected.

text: Gin-aprubahan na ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has approved the

text: ang pag-ilis sang apat ka quarter nga academic calendar, sa tatlo na lamang ka term, epektibo sugod sa School Year 2026–2027.
english: the replacement of the four-quarter academic calendar, with only three terms, effective from School Year 2026–2027.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leonil Salvilla, tagpababa sang Department of Education (DepEd) Schools Division of Iloilo, iya ginpaathag nga tinutuyo sang amo nga panibag-o nga sistema nga mapaayo ang kalidad sang pagtuon sang mga estudyante, pamaagi sa mas malawig kag tayuyon nga adlaw sang klase; mas hilway nga pacing sang lessons, ilabi na kun may suspensyon sang klase bangud sa bagyo ukon iba pa nga kalamidad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson of the Department of Education (DepEd) Schools Division of Iloilo, explained that the new system aims to improve the quality of learning of students, through longer and more consistent class days; more free pacing of lessons, especially when there is a suspension of classes due to typhoons or other disasters.

text: Dugang pa ni Salvilla nga sa idalum sang bag-o nga pagsulundan, makaangkun sang 54 ka adlaw sang klase kag 6 tubtub 10 ka adlaw para sa enrichment block sa Term 1 , 55 ka adlaw kag 6 tubtub 10 man ka adlaw nga enrichment block para sa Term 2, kag 61 ka adlaw sa Term 3 nga may 6 ka adlaw nga enrichment block.
english: Salvilla added that under the new rules, there will be 54 days of classes and 6 to 10 days for the enrichment block in Term 1, 55 days and 6 to 10 days of enrichment block for Term 2, and 61 days in Term 6 with an enrichment block of 3 days.

text: Ginapanan-aw nga mangin dako ini nga bulig sa mga estudyante, agud nga may yara ang mga ini sang mas tayuyun nga pag-eskwela, samtang mabuhinan man ang workload sang mga manunudlo bangud sa mas malip-ot nga grading cycle kag naka-schedule nga oras para sa pagpahuway.
english: This is expected to be a great help to the students, so that they have a more consistent schooling, while also reducing the workload of teachers due to the shorter grading cycle and scheduled time for rest.

text: Nagapadayon man nga igapatuman ang 180 minimum days sang klase sa tagsa ka school year, bilang kabahn sang reporma sa edukasyon.
english: The 180 minimum days of classes per school year will also continue to be implemented, as part of the education reform.

text: Ginklaro sang LPG Marketers Association sa publiko nga wala nila ginalantaw nga kulangon ang suplay sang liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sa pungsod sa masunod nga mga binulan, apang may ginaantisipar lang nga pagpanglakaak sa presyo.
english: The LPG Marketers Association has clarified to the public that they do not expect a shortage of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) supply in the country in the coming months, but only anticipate a price hike.

text: Ini apisar sang nauna nga estimate sang Department of Energy (DOE) nga magalawig na lang sang 24 ka adlaw ang suplay sang LPG as of March 20.
english: This is despite the previous estimate of the Department of Energy (DOE) that the supply of LPG will last only 24 days as of March 20.

text: Suno naman kay Arnel Ty, founder sang LPGMA, sa ila updated data, gina-project nga makalawig pa sang 35 tubtub 45 ka adlaw ang suplay nga may improvement ipaanggid sa data nga ginpresentar sang ahensya.
english: According to Arnel Ty, founder of LPGMA, in their updated data, the supply is projected to last 35 to 45 days with improvement compared to the data presented by the agency.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ginmanduan ang industriya nga mag-procure sang available nga LPG supply sa market kasunod sang ila meeting kay Energy Secretary Sharon Garin.
english: He said the industry was instructed to procure available LPG supply from the market following their meeting with Energy Secretary Sharon Garin.

text: Wala sang ginaantisipar nga shortage suno kay Ty bangud padayon man ang pagbakal sang pribado nga sektor kag naga-umpisa naman ang government-to-government sourcing arrangements.
english: Ty said no shortage is anticipated as the private sector continues to purchase and government-to-government sourcing arrangements are underway.

text: Apang kun may malain man nga balita, ini amo ang pagpanglakaak sang presyo bangud sang pagsaka man sang shipping costs.
english: But if there is bad news, it is the increase in prices due to the increase in shipping costs.

text: Ginalantaw sang grupo nga magalab-ot sa P1,400 tubtub P1,500 ang presyo sang kada tangke sa Abril.

english: The group also attributed the increase in shipping costs to the deterioration of routes in the Middle East due to the war, making the route via the United States, Africa, Canada, and Australia longer.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang DOE sa Senate hearing nga hugot ang ila monitoring sa LPG.
english: Earlier, the DOE said in the Senate hearing that it is closely monitoring LPG.

text: Lakip sa ila ginahimo amo ang paglibot sa mga restaurant kag beverages agud nga maabisuhan sila nga mapahagan-hagan anay ang paggamit ukon konsumo tubtub nga mag-abot ang dugang nga mga suplay.
english: Among their activities is to tour restaurants and beverages to advise them to ease their use or consumption until more supplies arrive.

text: Nagpasugot ang Iran kag ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa duha ka semana nga conditional ceasefire kasunod sang pagpatunga sang Pakistan.
english: Iran and the United States of America agreed to a two-week conditional ceasefire following mediation by Pakistan.
