text: Nangin positibo naman ang resulta bangud nag-upod sa iya higko ang Fabergé locket nga nagabalor sang kapin US$33,500 ukon yara sa ₱1,115,946.
english: The result was positive because his waste included a Fabergé locket worth more than US$33,500 or ₱1,115,946.

text: Igabalik naman ang pendant sa jewelry store matapos ang mga ginakinahanglan nga proseso.
english: The pendant will be returned to the jewelry store after the necessary processes.

text: Nag-atubang na sa korte ang akusado kag wala na nag-apelar sang plea sa kaso nga theft batok sa iya.
english: The accused has appeared in court and has not pleaded to the theft charge against him.

text: Sa isang pangyayaring puno ng pag-aalala ay napalitan ng liwanag at pag-asa, isang 66-anyos na babae ang sumailalim sa isang makabagong pamamaraan upang mailigtas ang kanyang puso.
english: In an event filled with worry that was replaced by light and hope, a 66-year-old woman underwent an innovative procedure to save her heart.

text: Ang mga monitor ay maingat na nagbabantay sa kanyang tibok, habang ang mga doktor ay nakatutok sa kanilang misyon, isang misyon na hindi lamang para sa pasyente, kundi para sa kasaysayan ng rehiyon.
english: The monitors are carefully watching his heartbeat, while the doctors are focused on their mission, a mission not only for the patient, but for the history of the region.

text: Noong Hulyo 23, naisagawa sa The Medical City Iloilo ang kauna-unahang Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) sa buong Western Visayas, isang hakbang na muling nagpatunay sa kakayahan ng rehiyon na manguna sa makabagong medisina.
english: On July 23, The Medical City Iloilo conducted the first Intravascular Lithotripsy (IVL) in the entire Western Visayas, a step that once again proved the region's ability to lead in innovative medicine.

text: Isang linggo lamang ang nakalipas mula nang isinagawa sa rehiyon ang una ring ‘awake brain surgery’, isang pambihirang tagumpay na kinilala sa buong bansa.
english: Only one week has passed since the first 'awake brain surgery' was performed in the region, a remarkable achievement recognized nationwide.

text: Ang IVL ay isang advanced, minimally invasive na procedure na gumagamit ng sound wave pulses upang durugin ang mga calcium buildup sa coronary arteries.
english: IVL is an advanced, minimally invasive procedure that uses sound wave pulses to break down calcium buildup in the coronary arteries.

text: Sa tulong nito, mas nagiging ligtas at epektibo ang paglalagay ng stent, at naiiwasan ang mas delikadong open-heart surgery, lalo na para sa mga pasyenteng may mataas na panganib.
english: With this, stent placement becomes safer and more effective, and more risky open-heart surgery is avoided, especially for high-risk patients.

text: Ang procedure ay isinagawa sa isang pasyente na may hypertension at family history ng coronary artery disease na natuklasang may malalang pagbabara ito sa tatlong coronary arteries, kabilang na ang critical na pagkipot sa left main coronary artery, isang kondisyon na karaniwang ginagamot sa pamamagitan ng bypass surgery.
english: The procedure was performed on a patient with hypertension and a family history of coronary artery disease who was diagnosed with severe blockage of three coronary arteries, including critical narrowing of the left main coronary artery, a condition commonly treated with bypass surgery.

text: Pinangunahan ng mga interventional cardiologists na sina Dr. Kristy Garganera-Tugbang ng Iloilo at Dr. James Diaz ng Ortigas ang operasyon, kasama si Dr. Felix Ruzen Fandinola (anesthesiologist) at ang buong team ng Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory.
english: Led by interventional cardiologists Dr. Kristy Garganera-Tugbang ng Iloilo and Dr. James Diaz of Ortigas conducted the operation, along with Dr. Felix Ruzen Fandinola (anesthesiologist) and the entire team of the Cardiac Catheterization Laboratory.

text: Sa panayam kay Dr. Kristy Garganera-Tugbang, sa programang Doctor Bombo ni Bombo Hannah Andasa, ibinahagi niyang imbes sa open-heart surgery, ay ginamit nila ang kombinasyon ng Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI), Intravascular Ultrasound (IVUS), at IVL upang ligtas na maibsan ang kondisyon ng pasyente.
english: In honor of Dr. Kristy Garganera-Tugbang, in Bombo Hannah Andasa's Doctor Bombo program, shared that instead of open-heart surgery, they used a combination of Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI), Intravascular Ultrasound (IVUS), and IVL to safely alleviate the patient's condition.

text: Sa loob lamang ng isang linggo, dalawang makasaysayang operasyon ang naisagawa sa Western Visayas; una sa utak, at ngayon, sa puso.
english: In just one week, two historic operations were conducted in Western Visayas; first in the brain, and now, in the heart.

text: Dalawang patunay na ang rehiyon ay hindi na kailangang tingnan bilang alternatibo sa pambansang antas ng serbisyong medikal.
english: Two proofs that the region does not need to be seen as an alternative to the national level of medical services.

text: Ito ay isa nang pangunahing haligi ng makabagong pangangalagang pangkalusugan.
english: It is a key pillar of modern health care.

text: Ang pagkakaroon ng mga teknolohiyang tulad ng IVL at IVUS sa rehiyon ay nagdadala ng konkretong benepisyo: mas mabilis ang paggaling, mas kaunti ang komplikasyon, at mas malapit sa mga tahanan ang lunas na dati ay kailangang hanapin sa malalayong lungsod.
english: The availability of technologies such as IVL and IVUS in the region brings concrete benefits: faster recovery, fewer complications, and closer to homes the treatment that previously had to be sought in remote towns.

text: Hindi lamang ito kwento ng isang pasyente, kundi kwento ng isang rehiyon na patuloy na tumitibok sa harap ng hamon.
english: This is not just the story of a patient, but the story of a region that continues to rise to the challenge.

text: Ang Western Visayas ay patuloy na humahakbang, hindi palayo, kundi papalapit sa pangarap na dekalidad at abot-kayang gamutan para sa lahat.
english: Western Visayas continues to move, not away, but closer to the dream of quality and affordable medicine for all.

text: Habang unti-unting naipupunla ang mga makabagong teknolohiya at kaalaman sa mga ospital sa rehiyon, kasabay rin nitong umuusbong ang panibagong mukha ng pag-asa, isang pag-asang may ngiti, may tibok, at may kinabukasan.
english: As modern technologies and knowledge are gradually being implemented in the region's hospitals, a new face of hope is also emerging, a hope with a smile, a beat, and a future.

text: Nagpaandam ang Malacañang nga kasuhan ang mga tawo nga nagapalapta sang fake news nga magapatuman sang lockdown ang gobyerno bangud sa problema sa suplay sang gatong kag bangud sa gina-alegar bag-o nga variant sang COVID-19.
english: Malacañang has warned that those who spread fake news that the government will implement a lockdown due to fuel supply problems and the alleged new variant of COVID-19 will be prosecuted.

text: Suno kay Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Secretary Dave Gomez, indi pag-itolerar sang Palasyo ang amo sini nga sahi sang malisyoso nga mga pahayag nga nagatuyo lang nga mapalapta ang ila personal kag pulitikal nga mga interes.
english: According to Presidential Communications Office (PCO) Secretary Dave Gomez, the Palace will not tolerate such malicious statements that only aim to spread their personal and political interests.

text: “In light of the current energy landscape, we warn anyone who deliberately fabricates stories and spreads fake news online to exploit the situation that they will be held to account to the fullest extent of the law,” suno kay Gomez.
english: “In light of the current energy landscape, we warn anyone who deliberately fabricates stories and spreads fake news online to exploit the situation that they will be held to account to the fullest extent of the law,” according to Gomez.

text: “There will be zero tolerance for those who maliciously and deliberately commit these acts to advance their personal or political vested interest,” dugang pa sang Malacañang official.
english: “There will be zero tolerance for those who maliciously and deliberately commit these acts to advance their personal or political vested interest,” the Malacañang official added.

text: Matandaan nga may naglapta sa social media nga may “emergency lockdown” nga maga-umpisa sa 20.
english: It can be recalled that there was a rumor on social media that there is an “emergency lockdown” that will start on the 20th.

text: May yara pa gid sang online post nga naga-unod man sang sala nga impormasyon nga may “emergency lockdown” nga himuon bangud sa COVID-19 Cicada variant.
english: There is also an online post that also contains false information that there will be an “emergency lockdown” due to the COVID-19 Cicada variant.

text: Sa amo nga post, gin-gamit pa ang logo sang health department agud mapagwa nga lehitimo ang iya post.
english: In the post, the logo of the health department was used to make his post look legitimate.

text: Suno sa PCO, gina-verify na nila ang original sources sang amo nga posts.
english: According to the PCO, they are verifying the original sources of the posts.

text: Nagpahanumdom ini nga ang pagpaguwa sang sala-sala nga mga impormasyon ang mahimo masilutan sang tubtub sa anum ka bulan nga pagkapreso sa idalom sang Article 154 sang Revised Penal Code.
english: He reminded that the release of false information is punishable by up to six months imprisonment under Article 154 of the Revised Penal Code.

text: Mahimo pa mag-isa ka tuig ang pagkapreso kun mapamatud-an nga ang sala ang nakomiter online ukon sakop na sang Republic Act No.
english: The offense can be imprisoned for up to one year if it is proven that the offense was committed online or is covered by Republic Act No.

text: 10175 ukon ang Cybercrime Prevention Act.
english: 10175 or the Cybercrime Prevention Act.

text: Suno pa sa Malacañang, makabig nga serious offense ang anuman nga tuyo nga patalangon ang publiko kaangot sa energy security, supply ukon presyuhanay subong sa tunga sang krisis dala sang gyera.
english: According to Malacañang, any attempt to mislead the public regarding energy security, supply or price changes in the midst of the crisis caused by the war is considered a serious offense.

text: Matandaan nga may anti-fake news nga gintukod ang PCO sang nagligad nga bulan nga may koordinasyon sa Department of Justice agud nga mapasakaan gilayon sang kaso ang nagapalapta sang deceptive information ukon naga-manipulate sang markets.
english: It can be recalled that the PCO established an anti-fake news last month in coordination with the Department of Justice to immediately prosecute those who spread deceptive information or manipulate the markets.

text: Gina-monitor sang PCO kag mga partner sini sa Oplan Kontra Fake News initiative ang social media kag iban pa nga information platforms agud ma-detect kag mabali gilayon kun may yara sang disinformation campaigns.#
english: The PCO and its partners in the Oplan Kontra Fake News initiative are monitoring social media and other information platforms to detect and disrupt disinformation campaigns immediately.

text: HILABTERO gid ining akon abyan nga si Pedro.
english: MY friend Pedro is a very nice guy.

text: Siling niya: “Indi ka lang maakig, ha… aton-aton lang ni, pero may nakahutik sa akon nga nakabaton ka kuno sang dawa-dawa nga pamaskwa nga nasulod sa isa ka madamol nga sobre halin sa pulitiko.
english: He said: “Don't be angry, ha... it's just ours, but someone told me that you received a fake Christmas gift in a thick envelope from a politician.

text: Tuod na, ga?
english: Really, huh?

text: Pila?
english: How much?

text:
Pwede mo ko da malibre sing panyaga?”

Nagkadlaw ako sing todo, kag nagsaligbat: “Ga, ga mo e… karon, makatulon ka gid jack…”

“Wala gid!” pamat-ud ko, “Ni Christmas card, ni ano pa… sumper man!
english:
Can you buy me lunch for free?”

I laughed out loud, and replied: “Ga, ga mo e… now, you can swallow jack…”

“Nothing at all!” I snapped, “No Christmas card, nothing… summer man!

text: Kon may yara man nga pamaskwa, indi halin sa pulitiko.
english: If there is any Christmas, it is not from a politician.

text: Halin sa mga tawo nga ginhatag sa akon sang Ginoo nga makahatag sing makabulusog sa balatyagon nga mga panamyaw, ang halin man sa exchange gifts nga ginahiwat namon nga mag-asawa, kag ang regalo sang akon kabataan kon diin nakabaton ako sang diutay nga galastuhon para sa bag-o ko nga kinahanglanon.
english: From the people the Lord has given me who can give heartwarming greetings, also from the exchange of gifts that my wife and I hold, and the gift of my children where I received a small expense for my new need.

text:
Kag ang ma-share ko man nga pang-ampaw para malipay ang mga kabataan nga dala sang mga abyan kag himata nga nagduaw sa amon.”

Kag dayon ko gindispatsa ang madugang pa mahambal ni Pedro, kag gintagaan ko ini sing pamaskwa.
english:
And the gift I can share to make the children happy that friends and relatives brought to visit us.”

And then I dispatched what Peter had to say, and I gave it a Christmas.

text:
“Ari duha ka gatos kag ipanyaga,” siling ko dala lahog… “magpangita ka dayon sang istoryahon mo, hehehe!”

***

Madamo sa aton ang seguro wala na makadumdum sa bagay nga pagselebrar sang Epiphany, ukon Adlaw sang Tatlo ka Hari – 3 Kings’ Day, ukon 3 Wise Men (Magi) Day – nga nagduaw kag naghatag sang regalo sa lapsag nga si Hesus, nga sunu kay Apostol Matthew sa Bibliya nagkilala sang pagka-King of Kings ni Hesus.
english:
"Here's two hundred and give it to me," I said with a smile... "you'll find someone to talk to, hehehe!"

***

Many of us probably do not remember the celebration of the Epiphany, or Day of the Three Kings – 3 Kings’ Day, or 3 Wise Men (Magi) Day – who visited and gave gifts to the baby Jesus, which according to the Apostle Matthew in the Bible recognized the King of Kings of Jesus.

text: Sadto gani, sa pila ka pungsod, ang pari naga-bendisyon sang tanan nga balay kag ginasulatan sang tisa (chalk) sang C+M+B sa lintel, ukon beam sa ibabaw sang ganhaan, nga gapadumdum nga nag-agi dira ang Tatlo ka Hari nga sanday Caspar, Melchor kag Balthazar.
english: In some countries, the priest used to bless all the houses and write C+M+B in chalk on the lintel, or beam above the door, reminding us that the Three Kings Caspar, Melchor and Balthazar passed through.

text: Maupdan pa ini sang tuig, katulad sang 20+C+M+B +26 para sa tuig 2026.
english: It will be accompanied by a year, such as 20+C+M+B +26 for 2026.

text: Sa pila ka lugar sa Filipinas, ginahiwatan man gani ini sang pyesta, nga sa karon, ugaling, okey na sa madamo  nga makaupod ukon magtan-aw na gid lang sa naga-prosesyon.
english: In some parts of the Philippines, it is even celebrated as a fiesta, which now, however, is okay for many to join or just watch the procession.

text:
May yara gani nga wala gid nakadumdum sa Adlaw sangTatlo ka Hari nga nagapamangkot pa sang: “San-o gani ang 3 Kings?”

Sa nahibal-an ko, kon wala ako nagsala, ginsaylo na ang petsa sang pagselebrar sang 3 Kings sa una nga Domingo (First Sunday) sang Enero, ukon sa Enero 4 sang sining tuig 2026.
english:
There are even those who do not remember the Day of the Three Kings who ask: “When are the 3 Kings?”

As far as I know, if I am not mistaken, the date of the celebration of the 3 Kings has been moved to the first Sunday of January, or to January 4 of this year 2026.

text: Sugod pa yadto sang 1969 sang nakita sang Simbahan Catolica ang pagka-kinahanglan nga madungan ini sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: It has been since 1969 when the Catholic Church saw the need to keep pace with other countries.

text:
***

Ang nagduaw nga tatlo ka Hari – Caspar (ukon Gaspar), Melchor kag Balthazar – sunu kay Apostol Matthew, naghatag gid ang kada sa ila sang ila mga regalo sa lapsag nga si Hesus.
english:
***

The three visiting Kings – Caspar (or Gaspar), Melchor and Balthazar – according to the Apostle Matthew, each of them gave their gifts to the baby Jesus.

text: Si Caspar naghatag sang Bulawan nga regalo sa pagkilala sini kay Hesus bilang King of Kings.
english: Caspar gave the Golden gift in recognition of Jesus as King of Kings.

text: Si Melchor naghatag sng Frankincense nga magamit sa pahamot (perfume) kag insenso sa pagpahayag sang pag-worship kag bagay nga “praise and adoration” kay Hesus.
english: Melchor gave Frankincense to be used in perfume and incense to express worship and praise and adoration to Jesus.

text: Si Balthazar naghatag sang Mirra (Myrrh), nga isa ka ointment nga mahumot nga pwede magamit bilang medisina ukon insenso man para sa pagpalubong sang ginataha nga pinalangga katulad sang matabo nga “suffering and death” ni Hesus.
english: Balthazar gave Myrrh, a fragrant ointment that could be used as medicine or incense for the burial of a loved one such as the suffering and death of Jesus.

text: Nakita sang Tatlo ka Hari ang lapsag nga si Hesus nga nahamtang sa isa ka pasungan (manger), sunu kay Apostol Lucas (Luke 13:15), nga ginapasudlan sang pagkaon sang hayop katulad sang kabayo, asno (donkey) kag baka.
english: The Three Kings saw the baby Jesus lying in a manger, according to the Apostle Luke (Luke 13:15), fed with animal food such as horses, donkeys and cattle.

text: Wala na gid sing maistaran (Inn) ang mag-asawa Jose kag Maria pag-abot sa Betlehem kag ginbaton na gid lang nila nga masayuhan ang gintugyan sa ila nga “lower part of a house or cave” upod sining mga hayop.
english: Joseph and Mary had no place to stay (Inn) when they arrived in Bethlehem and they accepted to live in the “lower part of a house or cave” with these animals.

text:
***

Nag-abot sa Bethlehem sanday Jose kag Maria, nga manugbata, agud magsunod sa mando ni sadto Roman Emperor Caesar Agustus nga magpa-census ang tanan sa Roman Empire sa ila natauhan (ancestral home) nga mga lugar.
english:
***

Joseph and Mary, who were about to give birth, arrived in Bethlehem to comply with the order of the then Roman Emperor Caesar Augustus to take a census of all in the Roman Empire in their ancestral homes.

text: Dira sa Bethlehem natawo si Jose, kon diin natawo man si King David, nga sang ulihi ginpamunuan na ni Haring Herodes sa tion sang pagpa-census na sang mag-asawa Jose kag Maria.
english: Joseph was born in Bethlehem, where King David was born, who was later ruled by King Herod at the time of the census of Joseph and Mary.

text: Gani naglakat ang mag-asawa Jose kag Maria halin sa siyudad sang Nazareth sang Galilee pakadto sa Bethlehem (Luke 2:4-5 NASV) tubtub natawo na si Hesus kag natultulan sang Tatlo ka Hari didto sa ginataguan sang mga hayop sa Bethelem paagi sa isa ka guiding star./PN
english: So Joseph and Mary walked from the city of Nazareth in Galilee to Bethlehem (Luke 2:4-5 NASV) until Jesus was born and was found by the Three Kings in the stable in Bethlehem through a guiding star./PN

text: Magapadayon ang preliminary investigation sang House Committee on Justice, batok sa impeachment complaints ni Bise Presidente Sara Duterte sa Marso 25, suno kay Batangas Rep.
english: The preliminary investigation of the House Committee on Justice, against the impeachment complaints of Vice President Sara Duterte will continue on March 25, according to Batangas Rep.

text: Gerville Luistro.
english: Gerville Luistro.

text: Paathag ni Luistro nga indi ini isa ka full trial, rason nga limitado lamang ang makatambong sa amo nga hearing.
english: Luistro explained that this is not a full trial, which is why only a limited number of people can attend the hearing.

text: Suno kay Luistro, ang mga abogado sang complainant, witness kag respondent lamang ang puwede nga maghatag sang advice sa ila kliyente, apang indi sila pagpahanungutan nga mag-itra sa deliberasyon ukon sa pagkwestyon.
english: According to Luistro, only the lawyers of the complainant, witness and respondent may give advice to their client, but they will not be allowed to participate in the deliberation or questioning.

text: Ang mga miyembro sang Justice Committee lamang ang sarang nga makapamangkot kag mag-cross-examine sang mga witnesses.
english: Only members of the Justice Committee are allowed to question and cross-examine witnesses.

text: Kaupod man sa restriction ang mga kongresista nga indi miyembro sang komite.
english: The restriction also includes congressmen who are not members of the committee.

text: Dugang pa ni Luistro nga tinutuyo sang preliminary investigation nga imbestigahan ang ebidensya kag hibaluon kun may probable cause agud nga magpadayon ang kaso.
english: Luistro added that the purpose of the preliminary investigation is to investigate the evidence and determine if there is probable cause so that the case can continue.

text: Kun may makit-an nga probable cause, igapasa ini sa bilog nga House of Representatives para sa masunod nga proseso.
english: If probable cause is found, it will be forwarded to the entire House of Representatives for further process.

text: Masobra 10,000 ka mga indibdiwal ang ginabulubanta nga nagpadulong sa mga beach resorts sa siudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo kahapon sang Domingo de Paskwa ukon Easter Sunday suno sa Philippine Coast Guard Iloilo Station.
english: More than 10,000 individuals are estimated to have visited beach resorts in Iloilo City and province yesterday on Easter Sunday, according to the Philippine Coast Guard Iloilo Station.

english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ensign.

english: El John Ga, spokesperson of the agency, said that as early as March 28, they have activated Malasakit Help Desks and Baywatch patrols in some parts of Iloilo.

text: Ini agud nga masiguro nga layo sa katalagman kag may mapalapitan gid ang mga beachgoers sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: This is to ensure that beachgoers are safe and have someone to turn to in times of emergency.

english: Now that the summer season has begun, PCG Iloilo will be patrolling daily for 24 hours to provide more security to those who want to enjoy their vacation at beach resorts in Iloilo City and province.

text: Ginpakaslan sang isa ka babaye nga si Yurina Noguchi ang isa ka AI-generated persona nga iya ginhingadlan nga “Klaus” sa ginpatigayon nga seremonya sa western Japan.
english: A woman named Yurina Noguchi married an AI-generated persona she named “Klaus” in a ceremony held in western Japan.

text: Nagsuksok sang puti nga Wedding gown kag tiara si Noguchi samtang nagatukar ang musika sa wedding hall, kag indi niya matago ang iya emosyon samtang nagalakat padulong sa nahamtangan ni Klaus nga ginapakita sa smartphone screen.
english: Noguchi wore a white Wedding gown and tiara as the music played in the wedding hall, and she couldn’t hide her emotions as she walked towards Klaus’ whereabouts shown on the smartphone screen.

text:
Nangin emosyonal si Noguchi sa pagpakigbahin sang iya nga wedding vow, kun sa diin iya ginpahayag nga ang iya relasyon sa AI indi isa ka “mahapos nga relasyon.”

Suno sa iya, ginpili niya si Klaus indi bilang paagi sa paglikaw sa realidad, kundi bilang isa ka persona nga magasuporta sa iya samtang nagakabuhi siya sing husto.
english:
Noguchi became emotional in sharing his wedding vow, where he said his relationship with AI was not an “easy relationship.”

She says she chose Klaus not as a way to escape reality, but as a figure to support her as she lives her life right.

text: Ang nasambit nga kasal ginakabig nga isa ka tumalagsahon nga hitabo nga nagapakita sang nagabag-o nga kahimtangan sang relasyon sa tunga sang tawo kag teknolohiya.
english: The said marriage is considered an extraordinary event that reflects the changing state of the relationship between man and technology.

text: Kasabay ng malamig na hangin at tila walang-katapusang ulan, may banta na hindi agad nakikita ng mata, tahimik, mabilis kumalat, at maaaring maging sanhi ng matinding karamdaman.
english: Along with the cold air and seemingly endless rain, there is a threat that is not immediately visible to the naked eye, is silent, spreads quickly, and can cause severe illness.

text: Sa bawat paglusong sa baha, maaaring kasabay nito ang panganib na dulot ng ”leptospirosis”, isang sakit na hindi palaging nabibigyan ng pansin ngunit patuloy na kumakalat sa maruruming tubig sa paligid.
english: With each flood, there is a danger of leptospirosis, a disease that is not always noticed but continues to spread in the surrounding polluted water.

text: Habang marami ang nag-aakalang simpleng lagnat lamang ang sintomas ng leptospirosis, may mga pagkakataong lumalala ito at humahantong sa seryosong komplikasyon o kamatayan.
english: While many people think that leptospirosis is a simple fever, it can worsen and lead to serious complications or death.

text: Sa mga bayan sa Iloilo na madalas tamaan ng pagbaha, ang sakit na ito ay hindi na banyaga sa maraming residente.
english: In the towns of Iloilo that are often hit by floods, this disease is no stranger to many residents.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay 𝗗𝗿.
english: Bombo Radyo's interview with 𝗗𝗿.

text: 𝗥𝗼𝗱𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝗥.
english: 𝗥𝗼𝗱𝗻𝗲𝘆 𝗥.

text: 𝗟𝗮𝗯𝗶𝘀, Provincial Health Officer I ng Iloilo, ibinahagi niya ang datos mula Enero hanggang Hulyo 19, 2025, kung saan umabot na sa 73 kaso ng leptospirosis ang naitala sa lalawigan, kabilang ang isang nasawi.
english: 𝗟𝗮𝗯𝗶𝘀, Provincial Health Officer I of Iloilo, he shared the data from January to July 19, 2025, where 73 cases of leptospirosis have been recorded in the province, including one recovery.

english: According to him, the cases came from 28 towns, with the highest number of cases in Janiuay and Oton (5 cases each), while four each were recorded in Alimodian, Badiangan, Dumangas, Lambunao, Leon, and Pototan.

english: National Basketball Association champion and Hall of Famer Dwight Howard is retiring from professional basketball.

english: According to the former basketball superstar, it is time to move on and pass on his knowledge of the sport to the next generation.

english: Howard said he could have given more to basketball, but he believes his new responsibility is to share his experience and know-how with the next generation of players.

english: Pope Leo XIV will personally carry the cross at the 14 stations of the Way of the Cross in the Colosseum, Rome, Italy on Good Friday in the said place.

english: This is the first time after several decades that the Pope will do so.

english: According to the Pope, this is a step that symbolizes people's solidarity with the suffering that Jesus went through.

text: Ginkontra ni Presidential Communications Office Undersecretary Claire Castro ang pahayag ni Senator Sherwin Gatchalian nga nagapangatubang na sang krisis sa gatong ang pungsod bangud sa padayon nga pagtaas sang presyo sang mga produktong petrolyo.
english: Presidential Communications Office Undersecretary Claire Castro countered Senator Sherwin Gatchalian's statement that the country is already facing a fuel crisis due to the continuous rise in the price of petroleum products.

text: Suno kay Castro nga indi pa matawag nga oil crisis ang sitwasyon subong bangud wala pa ginakulang ang suplay sang Pilipinas sa langis.
english: Castro said the current situation cannot be called an oil crisis because the Philippines' supply of oil is not yet in short supply.

text: Dugang pa sini nga may ginapaabot nga diesel sa masunod nga semana, nga ginbakal sang Department of Energy halin sa kaiping nga mga pungsod sa Asya.
english: He added that diesel is expected next week, purchased by the Department of Energy from neighboring Asian countries.

text: Nagpasalig naman si Castro nga padayon ang ginahimo nga negosasyon sang gobyerno, agud nga indi magkulang ang supply sang produktong petrolyo sa pungsod.
english: Castro assured that the government is continuing its negotiations, so that there is no shortage of petroleum products in the country.

english: As a result, fans at the Kaseya Center in Miami cheered and applauded.

Diri sa Misuse of Public Office seguro gin-igu sang mga akusasyon si VP Sara angot sa wala niya mapahayag nga paggamit sang Confidential Fund, nga samtang “confidential” yara sa Ovesight function ukon poder sang COA, ukon DILG sa bahin sang mga local government, sa pag-limite kag pag-usisa for purposes sang Transparency kag Accountability, nga wala ginpaathag ni VP Sara.
english:
***

Here in the Misuse of Public Office, VP Sara was probably hit by accusations regarding his undisclosed use of the Confidential Fund, which while “confidential” is in the oversight function or power of the COA, or DILG on the part of local governments, to limit and investigate for purposes of Transparency and Accountability, which VP Sara did not approve.

text: Sa pag-usisa sang COA, nagamit ni VP Sara ang daku nga bahin sang badyet sang Office of the Vice Presidengt (OVP) sa Confidential Fund nga sobra sa limite sang matugot sang COA.
english: According to the COA, VP Sara used a large part of the budget of the Office of the Vice Presidengt (OVP) in the Confidential Fund which is more than the limit allowed by the COA.

text: Nagagwa sa pag-usisa sang COA nga lapaw sa tugot nga alokasyon sang CF para sa OVP sing mga 60 ka porsyento.
english: It appears from the COA assessment to exceed the allowable CF allocation for OVP by about 60 per cent.

text: Nga sa nasiling ta na sa ibabaw wala mapaathag ni VP Sara.
english: As we said above, VP Sara did not explain.

text: Diri nga isyu natumod karon ang akusasyon batok kay VP Sara – ang indi niya mapaathag nga kaundan sang iya Confidential Fund sunu sa kinahanglan sang Transparency kag Accountability sang paggamit sini, nga luyag lang sabton ni VP Sara sa husgado.
english: This issue now focuses on the accusation against VP Sara – his inability to explain the contents of his Confidential Fund in accordance with the requirements of Transparency and Accountability of its use, which VP Sara just wants to answer in court.

text: Ini ang paglaragway sang fisherfolk group sa ginpasalig sang gobyerno nga fuel subsidies para sa mga manugpangisda sa tunga sang nagatimbuok nga presyo sang gatong nga naga-apekto man sa ila nga operasyon kag palangabuhian.
english: This is the fisherfolk group's description of the government's promised fuel subsidies for fishermen amid the rising fuel prices that are also affecting their operations and livelihoods.

text: Suno kay Fernando Hicap, national chairperson sang PAMALAKAYA, madamo pa sa ila ang wala pa gihapon nakabaton sang ayuda apisar nga manug-apat na ka semana ang gyera kag apat ka semana naman nga may nagapanglakaak nga oil price hikes.
english: According to Fernando Hicap, national chairperson of PAMALAKAYA, many of them have not yet received the aid despite the four weeks of war and four weeks of oil price hikes.

text: “Yung pangako nila na tatlong libo, actually sabi nila 2025 budget pa ‘to no doon sa fuel subsidy hanggang ngayon wala pa… halos tatlong linggo na itong sumirit yung presyo ng gasolina na halos doble na yung gastos ng mangingisda kaya napakabagal at wala pa talagang natatanggap yung mga mangingisda,” suno kay Hicap.
english: "Their promise of three thousand, actually they said 2025 budget pa 'to no there fuel subsidy until now no ... almost three weeks that the price of gasoline has risen that almost double the cost of fishermen so very slow and nothing really received the fishermen," according to Hicap.

text: Sa data sang gobyerno, 14,000-15,000 lamang ang covered sang ayuda, apisar nga masobra 300,000 ang rehistrado nga municipal fishers.
english: According to government data, only 14,000-15,000 are covered by the aid, although more than 300,000 are registered municipal fishermen.

text: Bangud sang mataas nga presyo sang gatong suno sa grupo, madamo sa manugpangisda ang wala na nagakadto sa dagat bangud indi na masarangan ang operating costs.
english: Due to the high price of fuel, the group said, many of the fishermen are no longer going to the sea because they can no longer afford the operating costs.

text: Magluwas diri, napilitan man ang iban suno sa iya nga mag-share na lang sa sakayan, ukon duha tubtub tatlo ukon tag-lima pa gid ka tawo sa kada bangka rason nga mas gamay man ang ila nga income.
english: Besides, he said, some are forced to share the boat, or two to three or five people in each boat, which is why their income is lower.

text: “Bago pa man tumaas ‘to… nasa 80% na ang total na gastos namin napupunta sa gasolina… kaya ngayon yung iba hindi na kayang makapangisda, nakikisama na lang sa may kapasidad,” dugang ni Hicap.
english: “Before it went up... 80% of our total expenses went to gasoline... so now the others can't afford to fish, they just join those who have the capacity,” Hicap added.

text: Ginasulit sang grupo ang panawagan nga dasigon man kag mangin inclusive sa pagpanagtag sang ayuda nga labi nila nga kinahanglan.#
english: The group reiterates its call to speed up and be inclusive in the distribution of aid that they need most.

text: Ginkasadya sang LGBTQ+ celebrity couple nga sanday Ice Seguerra kag Liza Diño ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga nagakilala sang co-ownership sang mga propidad para sa mga same-sex couple nga upod nagapuyo sa isa ka balay.
english: LGBTQ+ celebrity couple Ice Seguerra and Liza Diño welcomed the Supreme Court's decision recognizing co-ownership of properties for same-sex couples living together in the same house.

text: Base sa ruling nga ginpasar sang Korte Suprema, pwede kilalahon bilang co-owners ang mga same-sex partners base sa ila aktuwal nga kontribusyon sa propidad nga ila ginapanag-iyahan.
english: Based on the ruling passed by the Supreme Court, same-sex partners can be recognized as co-owners based on their actual contribution to the property they own.

text: Ginklaro man sang ini nga layi nga ang gintingob nga mga propidad sang same-sex couple nadala sa article 148 kun sa diin pareho sang mga ini nga matingob ang ila propidad apisar indi pa legal ang pagpakasal sang same-sex couple.
english: The law also clarifies that the joint properties of a same-sex couple are covered by article 148 where both of them have joint property even if the same-sex couple is not yet legally married.

text:
Nahibaluan nga ginkasal si Aiza Seguera kag Liza Diño sang tuig 2024 sa California kun sa diin legal ang same sex marriage

Masobra isa ka dekada na nga naga-upod si Seguerra kag Diño kun sa diin kilala ang mga ini nga nagapakigbato sa mga kinamatarong sang LGBTQ+.
english:
Aiza Seguera and Liza Diño will be married in 2024 in California where same sex marriage is legal

Seguerra and Diño have been together for more than a decade and are known for fighting for LGBTQ+ rights.

text: Suno sa report, bisan absent ang iya mga empleyado, nagakatingala ini nga may record sila sa facial recognition system sang kumpanya.
english: According to the report, even though his employees were absent, he was surprised that they had a record in the company's facial recognition system.

text: Nadiskubrehan sang employer paagi sa isa ka CCTV footage nga nagagamit sang maskara nga papel nga may nawong sang mga empleyado nga ma-recognize sang ila biometric agud makasweldo apisar wala nagasulod sa trabaho.
english: The employer discovered through a CCTV footage that the employees were using paper masks with their faces to be recognized by their biometrics in order to get paid despite not coming to work.

english: He arrested one of his men who is believed to be the mastermind in doing the said thing.

english: Because of this work, many netizens condemned their actions, and recommended kicking them out of work, especially now that many are looking for work.

text: Masobra 15,000 ka evacuees sa syudad ang nahatagan na sang prophylaxis ukon bulong kontra leptospirosis, suno sa City Health Office.
english: More than 15,000 evacuees in the city have already been given prophylaxis or treatment against leptospirosis, according to the City Health Office.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Ann Diaz, hepe sang CHO, ginpahayag sini nga kada may pagbaha kag sa panahon sang ulan, awtomatiko nga nagahatag sila sang doxycycline prophylaxis sa mga residente nga na-expose sa tubig baha.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Ann Diaz, chief of the CHO, said that whenever there is flooding and during the rainy season, they automatically provide doxycycline prophylaxis to residents exposed to flood waters.

text: Gindugang pa ni Dr. Diaz nga may mga medical team man nga ginapahamtang sa mga evacuation center para mag-assess sang kondisyon sang evacuees, maghatag sang konsultasyon kag bulong nga kinahanglan.
english: He added that Dr. Diaz said medical teams are also being deployed at the evacuation centers to assess the condition of the evacuees, provide consultation and medication as needed.

text: Ginahimo man ini sa mga kabarangayan paagi sa house-to-house medical outreach.
english: This is also done in the barangays through house-to-house medical outreach.

text: Ginpanugyan man sang City Health Office sa publiko nga mag-inom sang prophylaxis kung nakaubog sa baha agud malikawan ang balatian nga leptospirosis.
english: The City Health Office also advised the public to take prophylaxis after flooding to prevent leptospirosis.

text: Ginhingyo ni Pope Leo XIV sa presidente sang Israel nga buksan liwat ang tanan nga banas para sa dayalogo agud nga mauntat na ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: Pope Leo XIV has asked the Israeli president to reopen all paths for dialogue so that the war in the Middle East can end.

text: Pareho nga ginkumpirma sang opisina sang Santo Papa kag ni President Isaac Herzog nga nag-istoryahanay ang duha paagi sa telepono.
english: Both the Pope’s office and President Isaac Herzog confirmed that the two spoke by phone.

text:
Suno sa statement nga gin-release sang Holy See Press Office, “during the conversation, the need to reopen all possible channels of diplomatic dialogue was reiterated, in order to put an end to the serious ongoing conflict, with a view to achieving a just and lasting peace throughout the Middle East.”

Samtang nagpadayon ang diskusyon suno sa Vatican, ginhatagan sang igtalupangod ang importansya sa paghatag sang proteksyon sa civilian population kag sa pagtib-ong sang respeto para sa international kag humanitarian law.
english:
According to a statement released by the Holy See Press Office, “during the conversation, the need to reopen all possible channels of diplomatic dialogue was reiterated, in order to put an end to the serious ongoing conflict, with a view to achieving a just and lasting peace throughout the Middle East.”

As the discussion continued, the Vatican said, attention was paid to the importance of providing protection to the civilian population and promoting respect for international and humanitarian law.

text: Sa statement naman sang opisina ni Herzog, ginsiling nga na-istoryahan man nila sang Santo Papa ang Iranian missile attacks sa Jerusalem nga nagtupa sa areas nga balaan para sa mga Kristiyano, Muslims, kag Jews.
english: In a statement, Herzog's office said they also discussed with the Pope the Iranian missile attacks on Jerusalem that fell on areas holy to Christians, Muslims, and Jews.

text: Gin-istoryahan man suno sa opisina ni Herzog ang sitwasyon sa Lebanon kun sa diin naga-away ang Israel kag ang Hezbollah terror group nga nag-intra sa gyera sa Middle East sang damlag lang.
english: Herzog's office also discussed the situation in Lebanon, where Israel and the Hezbollah terror group, which recently joined the war in the Middle East, are fighting.

text: Pebrero 28 sang nagsugod ang tensyon sang Iran, US, kag Israel nga subong naglapta na sa bilog nga rehiyon.

text: Sa gitna ng malamig na operating room sa Iloilo City, sa ilalim ng matitingkad na puting ilaw at huni ng makinaryang panmedikal, isang pasyente ang nakahiga, gising, hindi nakakakilos, ngunit mulat sa bawat segundo ng kanyang pakikipaglaban.
english: In the middle of a cold operating room in Iloilo City, under the bright white lights and sounds of medical machinery, a patient lies, awake, unable to move, crying every second of his struggle.

text: Bukas ang kanyang bungo, tanaw ang maselang bahagi ng utak, habang ang kanyang tinig ay naririnig pa rin, sumasagot sa mga tanong, sumusunod sa utos, at nagpapakita ng lakas ng loob na bihira sa ganitong sandali.
english: His skull was open, the sensitive part of his brain visible, while his voice was still heard, answering questions, following orders, and showing a courage that was rare in this moment.

text: Sa paligid niya, tahimik ngunit alerto ang mga kamay ng mga espesyalista.
english: Around him, the hands of specialists were quiet but alert.

text: Ito ang makasaysayang tagpo sa likod ng kauna-unahang ‘awake craniotomy’ na isinagawa sa Panay Island, isang operasyong hindi lang isinagawa sa utak, kundi pinanday ng tapang at tiwala.
english: This is the historic meeting behind the first 'awake craniotomy' performed on Panay Island, an operation that was not only performed on the brain, but was forged with courage and confidence.

text: Ang procedure ay isinagawa sa Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC) sa pangunguna ni Dr. Derek Ben T. Jabines, isang neurosurgeon at spine surgeon na nagsanay sa General Surgery at patuloy na hinasa sa larangan ng Neurosurgery sa ilalim ng Southern Philippines Integrated Neurosurgical Training Program, isang consortium ng Davao Doctors Hospital at WVMC.
english: The procedure was performed at the Western Visayas Medical Center (WVMC) under the leadership of Dr. Derek Ben T. Jabines, a neurosurgeon and spine surgeon who trained in General Surgery and continues to be trained in the field of Neurosurgery under the Southern Philippines Integrated Neurosurgical Training Program, a consortium of Davao Doctors Hospital and WVMC.

text: Sa ekslusibong panayam ng Bombo Radyo sa programang ”Doctor Bombo”, ikinuwento ni Dr. Jabines ang anim na oras na operasyon sa isang pasyente na may tumor sa tinatawag na eloquent areas ng utak, mga bahaging may kinalaman sa pagsasalita at paggalaw.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo on the program "Doctor Bombo", Dr. Jabines performed a six-hour operation on a patient with a tumor in the so-called eloquent areas of the brain, the parts involved in speech and movement.

text: Dahil sa kritikal na lokasyon ng tumor, hindi naging opsyon ang karaniwang general anesthesia.
english: Due to the critical location of the tumor, conventional general anesthesia was not an option.

text: Sa halip, pinili ng team ang isang mas masalimuot na ruta: awake craniotomy, kung saan nananatiling gising at kausap ang pasyente sa mahahalagang yugto ng operasyon.
english: Instead, the team chose a more involved route: awake craniotomy, where the patient remains awake and talkative during the crucial stages of the operation.

text: Hindi niya ito tinawid nang mag-isa.
english: He did not cross it alone.

text: Si Dr. James Mercado, kapwa neurosurgeon mula sa Davao Doctors Hospital, ay katuwang niya sa operasyon.
english: Drs. James Mercado, a fellow neurosurgeon from Davao Doctors Hospital, was his partner in the operation.

text: Pinanatiling ligtas at kalmado ang pasyente sa tulong ni Dr. Ceres Lucot-Laud, expert sa neuroanesthesia, habang si Dr. Paul Christian Sobrevega, isang neuropsychiatrist, ang nagsagawa ng intraoperative testing upang masigurong ligtas at aktibo ang mahahalagang brain functions habang tinatanggal ang tumor.
english: The patient was kept safe and calm with the help of Dr. Ceres Lucot-Laud, expert in neuroanesthesia, while Dr. Paul Christian Sobrevega, a neuropsychiatrist, conducted intraoperative testing to ensure that vital brain functions were safe and active while the tumor was being removed.

text: Ayon kay Dr. Jabines, isinailalim sa masusing mental at physical preparation ang pasyente bago ang operasyon.
english: According to Dr. Jabines, the patient is undergoing thorough mental and physical preparation before the operation.

text: Hindi biro ang pagharap sa scalpel nang gising, ngunit sa dedikasyon ng team at tapang ng pasyente, matagumpay nilang naabot ang layunin: ang pagtanggal ng tumor habang pinapanatiling buo ang kanyang kakayahang magsalita, gumalaw, at mabuhay nang normal.
english: Facing the scalpel while awake was not a joke, thanks to the dedication of the team and the courage of the patient, they successfully achieved the goal: the removal of the tumor while maintaining his ability to speak, move, and live normally.

text: Ang tagumpay na ito ay patunay na hindi na kailangang lumuwas ng Maynila o lumipad paabroad para makamit ang highly specialized brain surgery.
english: This success is proof that you don't have to leave Manila or fly abroad to get highly specialized brain surgery.

text: Sa puso ng Panay, may mga kamay na bihasa, may sistemang handa, at higit sa lahat, may tapang at tiwalang kayang humawak sa mga buhay sa oras ng panganib.
english: In the heart of Panay, there are skilled hands, a ready system, and above all, courage and confidence that can hold lives in times of danger.

text: Sa bawat hakbang ng operasyon, hindi lang teknolohiya ang umiral, kundi ang koneksyon sa pagitan ng doktor at pasyente, ang tiwala sa proseso, at ang lakas ng loob sa gitna ng katahimikan.
english: At every step of the operation, not only technology is important, but the connection between doctor and patient, trust in the process, and courage in the midst of silence.
